cinder.name: The Cinder Vaults
cinder.premise: Dwarven forge-halls that never cooled. Iron doors, slag rivers, and a heat that builds with every step.

meter.name: Heat
meter.text: Hot rooms raise Heat. At 3+, fights begin with the party burning but Ember and Steel dice score +1 Mult. Find a cooling cistern to reset it.

atmosphere: Heat rolls off the walls in waves.
Somewhere below, metal rings on metal.
The air tastes of copper and smoke.
details: A cart of slag has frozen mid-pour.
Rune-plates on the wall have half melted.
Chains sway though there is no wind.
A dwarf-sized helmet lies steaming on the floor.
Old soot handprints climb the wall.
hooks: a fighter's old shield-brother went missing here
the Keep's smith wants a lost recipe

rootbound.name: The Rootbound Halls
rootbound.premise: A necropolis swallowed by a living forest. Every footstep wakes the spores.

meter.name: Bloom
meter.text: Every step raises Bloom. At 3+, foes regenerate, but Verdant dice score +4 Chips. Quiet groves reset your Bloom level.

atmosphere: It smells of rain on graves.
details: A skeleton is cradled in a root like a hammock.
Names on the tombs have been eaten by lichen.
A shrine bell hangs choked by vines.
Mushrooms grow in a perfect ring.
Something has dug its way out of a grave.
anomalies: every root leads to one heart
hooks: a cleric's old master was buried here
the Apothecary needs a rare glowcap

drowned.name: The Drowned Archive
drowned.premise: An astronomers' library sank beneath an inverted tide. Brass pumps still move the water between wings.

meter.name: Water
meter.text: Pump levers raise or lower the water. Low water opens flooded passages; high water gives Storm and Frost dice +2 Mult but foes resist cold.

details: A brass orrery turns slowly underwater.
A ledger lists the drowned in neat handwriting.
Shelves lean together like tired friends.
An eel coils around a reading lamp.
A star chart is pinned to the ceiling.
hooks: a wizard's missing tutor catalogued this wing
the Cartographer wants the old star charts

mirror.name: The Mirror Reliquary
mirror.premise: A cathedral built to trap a god inside its reflections. Facing matters here: doors exist only in the right light.

meter.name: Reflection
meter.text: Mirror rooms swap Left and Right. Visiting mirrored rooms raises Reflection; at 3, hidden mirror-doors reveal themselves.

atmosphere: Your reflections move a heartbeat late.
Light splits into colours that have no names.
Every surface shows a different room.
The floor is a mirror; the sky beneath it is wrong.
details: A reflection waves at you. You did not wave.
A stained-glass saint has your face.
Shards hang in the air, motionless.
A cracked mirror shows the boss room.
Prayer candles burn with reversed flames.
anomalies: reflections are trying to swap places
a god is cracking the glass from inside
objectives: free a hero trapped in a reflection
hooks: a rogue swears they saw their double here
the Enchanter wants a perfect lens

tag.label: Mirrored — Left and Right are swapped

starfall.name: The Starfall Ossuary
starfall.tagline: Floating graves and silent cosmic machinery.
starfall.premise: A tomb-city adrift among fallen stars. Gravity shifts as the ossuary turns.

meter.name: Gravity
meter.text: Every few steps gravity turns, rotating your directions. Low gravity grants +1 reroll in fights. Anchor shrines stabilise it.

atmosphere: Graves drift past like slow boats.
There is no sound at all.
Starlight pours through a hole in the world.
Your hair floats as gravity slips.
details: A meteor is embedded in a sarcophagus.
Constellations are painted on a skull.
A bell rings with no clapper.
Bones orbit a small dead star.
A pilgrim's lantern still burns.
hooks: a warlock's patron whispers of this place
the Keep's founder is buried here

thievesTools.name: Thieves' Tools
thievesTools.text: Proficient users gain advantage on lockpicking and trap checks.

bracersDefense.name: Bracers of Defense
bracersDefense.text: +2 AC while wearing no armor and no shield.

pearlPower.name: Pearl of Power
pearlPower.text: Once per expedition, recover a spell slot of 3rd level or lower at a safe room.

periaptWound.name: Periapt of Wound Closure
periaptWound.text: +10% max HP; you stabilise automatically when downed.

luckstone.name: Luckstone
luckstone.text: +1 to saves and +1 reroll on your turns.

rodPact.name: Rod of the Pact Keeper
rodPact.text: +1 spell save DC and spell attacks.

wandWar.name: Wand of the War Mage
wandWar.text: +1 spell attack rolls and save DC.

hawkEye.name: Falconer's Eye
hawkEye.text: Critical hits on one lower d20 face.

diceOfTheDoor.name: Bone of the Sixth Door
diceOfTheDoor.text: An old die-bone that hums near the door: +1 reroll, +1 AC, +1 saves.

glovesThievery.name: Gloves of Thievery
glovesThievery.text: +5 Sleight of Hand, and its Palm trick: swap a tray die for the next one in the bag.

bootsElvenkind.name: Boots of Elvenkind
bootsElvenkind.text: +5 Stealth, and its Lurk trick: reroll one die for free.

eyesEagle.name: Eyes of the Eagle
eyesEagle.text: +5 Perception, and its Spot trick: a die's face turns Keen.

hatDisguise.name: Hat of Disguise
hatDisguise.text: +5 Deception, and its Bluff trick: a die turns Wild.

dossLute.name: Doss Lute
dossLute.text: +5 Performance and one extra skill trick each fight.

iounInsight.name: Ioun Stone of Insight
iounInsight.text: Insight proficiency and one extra skill trick each fight.

bagTricks.name: Bag of Tricks
bagTricks.text: Every fight starts with a Wild ghost die on the tray.

ivoryBones.name: Ivory Knucklebones
ivoryBones.text: Adds a Loaded Die to the bag on every expedition.

goldbugLocket.name: Goldbug Locket
goldbugLocket.text: Adds a Goldbug Die (three gilded faces) to the bag on every expedition.

glassEye.name: Glass Eye of Fortune
glassEye.text: Adds a Glass Die (×2 Mult, may shatter) to the bag on every expedition.

prismShard.name: Prism Shard Pendant
prismShard.text: Adds a Prism Die (counts as every material) to the bag on every expedition.

gamblersPurse.name: Gambler's Purse
gamblersPurse.text: Start every expedition with a Fate Coin.

encoreHourglass.name: Hourglass of Encores
encoreHourglass.text: Start every expedition with an Encore token.

boneCirclet.name: Circlet of Bone
boneCirclet.text: Bone dice count as your colour (+1 Mult each).

fourWinds.name: Band of the Four Winds
fourWinds.text: Ember, Frost and Storm dice count as your colour.

twinRing.name: Ring of Twin Fortune
twinRing.text: Your Pairs and Two Pairs gain +3 Mult.

threesBracelet.name: Bracelet of Threes
threesBracelet.text: Your Three of a Kinds and Full Houses gain +4 Mult.

starweave.name: Starweave Mantle
starweave.text: Your Straights and Straight Sets gain ×1.5 Mult.

hoardTorc.name: Torc of the Hoard
hoardTorc.text: Your Sets, Full Sets and Dragon Hoards gain ×2 Mult.

alchemistsFire.name: Alchemist's Fire
alchemistsFire.text: Hurl: 2d6 fire and the target burns.

holyWater.name: Holy Water
holyWater.text: 2d8 radiant to a fiend or undead (half to others).

potionHeroism.name: Potion of Heroism
potionHeroism.text: 10 temp HP (× vitality) and Bless for the fight.

smokeBomb.name: Smoke Bomb
smokeBomb.text: Escape from a non-boss fight (lose this room's rewards).

campSupplies.name: Camp Supplies
campSupplies.text: Take a short rest anywhere that is not a combat room.

diamond.name: Resurrection Diamond
diamond.text: Revive a fallen hero at a safe room (consumed).

luckyCharm.name: Gambler's Rabbit Foot
luckyCharm.text: Gain a Mulligan Coin for this expedition.

scrollCure.name: Scroll of Cure Wounds
scrollCure.text: Cast Cure Wounds (1st). Anyone can read it.

scrollFireball.name: Scroll of Fireball
scrollFireball.text: Cast Fireball (3rd). Anyone can read it.

scrollShield.name: Scroll of Shield of Faith
scrollShield.text: Cast Shield of Faith. Anyone can read it.

scrollRevivify.name: Scroll of Revivify
scrollRevivify.text: Cast Revivify on an ally who fell this fight.

ladyLuck.name: Lady Luck's Rapier
ladyLuck.text: Your High Die plays gain +4 Mult: one die at a time is a strategy now.

legend.lore: A riverboat gambler won it on a single die and never rolled two again.

spellthiefKris.name: Spellthief's Kris
spellthiefKris.text: Attack and damage with your spellcasting ability if it is higher. Casters can fight in melee.

legend.lore: A blade-dancer's wavy dagger that answers to the mind rather than the arm.

bloodCleaver.name: Bloodthirst Cleaver
bloodCleaver.text: +30% damage while you are at or below half HP; heal 5% of damage dealt; −1 AC.

legend.lore: An oversized black cleaver from a mercenary legend: it grows hungrier the more its wielder bleeds.

frostbrand.name: Frost Brand
frostbrand.text: +1d6 cold on hit; resistance to fire; Frost dice count as your colour.

legend.lore: Forged in a glacier's heart, it sheds pale light and puts out flames.

starshotBow.name: Starshot Longbow
starshotBow.text: Your Straights and Straight Sets gain ×1.5 Mult; +2 initiative.

legend.lore: Each arrow loosed from it draws a line of stars, one point after the next.

twinGale.name: Twin Gale Blade
twinGale.text: Your attack action always strikes at least twice, but your weapon damage is 15% lower.

legend.lore: A wind-spirit's sword that cuts once and echoes once, whoever holds it.

dragonfang.name: Dragonfang Greatsword
dragonfang.text: +25% damage against elites and bosses; −2 initiative.

legend.lore: Too big to be called a sword: a slab of iron hammered from a dragon's fallen tooth.

earthshaker.name: Earthshaker Maul
earthshaker.text: +1d6 thunder on hit; your overkill carries into the next foe.

legend.lore: Giants used it to drive mountain roots. One swing never stops at one body.

stormcaller.name: Stormcaller Hammer
stormcaller.text: +1d8 lightning on hit; resistance to lightning; Storm dice count as your colour.

legend.lore: A sky-god's hammer that only the worthy can lift.

moonreaper.name: Moonreaper Glaive
moonreaper.text: +1d8 necrotic on hit; heal 12% of damage dealt; healing from others is halved on you.

legend.lore: A reaper's polearm that feeds its bearer and nobody else.

ninelives.name: Nine Lives Stealer
ninelives.text: When you kill a foe: heal 10% of max HP and gain a reroll; −10% max HP.

legend.lore: A duellist's blade with nine notches on the guard. It is always hungry for the tenth.

vorpal.name: Vorpal Sword
vorpal.text: Crits on one lower face; a crit kills any non-boss foe at or below 25% HP outright.

legend.lore: Snicker-snack. The oldest legend in the Keep.

staffMagi.name: Staff of the Magi
staffMagi.text: +1 spell save DC and attack; +4 damage on every spell; one extra 5th-level slot.

legend.lore: The staff of an archmage who outlived their own legend.

starcleaver.name: Starcleaver
starcleaver.text: +15% damage; every fight opens with a Wild ghost die on the tray.

legend.lore: The hero's sword at the end of the story, made from the star that fell over the Keep.

glamouredLeather.name: Glamoured Studded Leather
glamouredLeather.text: Deception proficiency (+3) and its Bluff trick; +1 initiative.

legend.lore: Armor that looks like a fine coat until the knives come out.

mithralShirt.name: Mithral Shirt
mithralShirt.text: A chain shirt that counts as LIGHT armor: AC 13 + full DEX. Any class trained in light armor can wear it.

legend.lore: Woven by deep-delving smiths from silver-bright mithral, light as silk.

sentinelShield.name: Sentinel Shield
sentinelShield.text: +4 initiative; Perception proficiency and its Spot trick.

legend.lore: An eye painted on its face never closes.

dragonscale.name: Red Dragon Scale Mail
dragonscale.text: Resistance to fire; Ember dice count as your colour.

legend.lore: Scales shed by a red dragon, still warm to the touch.

demonArmor.name: Demon Armor
demonArmor.text: Your unarmed strikes become 1d8 claws, so you can fight bare-handed in plate; −1 to all saves.

legend.lore: Fiend-forged plate whose gauntlets end in talons. It whispers.

invulnerable.name: Armor of Invulnerability
invulnerable.text: The first hit you take each fight deals no damage.

legend.lore: Plate that the first blow of any battle simply slides off.

wolfPelt.name: Wolfmother's Pelt
wolfPelt.text: +1 Rage; heal 3% of max HP at the start of each of your turns.

legend.lore: The pelt of a great white wolf who mothered a whole tribe.

efreetiChain.name: Efreeti Chain
efreetiChain.text: Resistance to fire; melee attackers take fire damage equal to your level.

legend.lore: Chain woven from the brass of the City of Fire.

dawnPlate.name: Plate of the Unbroken Oath
dawnPlate.text: The first time you would drop to 0 HP each fight, you stay at 1; healing you receive +25%.

legend.lore: A paladin's armor that held the line for a hundred years.

dragonboneAegis.name: Dragonbone Aegis
dragonboneAegis.text: Resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning and poison; −2 initiative.

legend.lore: Carved from a skull-plate of one of the Dragon Queen's fallen consorts.

foxMask.name: Fox Spirit Mask
foxMask.text: Each fight opens with a Wild ghost die on the tray; Deception proficiency and its Bluff trick.

legend.lore: A shrine fox's white mask. Wear it and luck mistakes you for a friend.

ringSpellStoring.name: Ring of Spell Storing
ringSpellStoring.text: Spellcasters gain an extra 1st- and 2nd-level spell slot.

legend.lore: A ring that keeps a spell or two tucked away for later.

robeStars.name: Robe of Stars
robeStars.text: +2 damage on every spell; +1 to all saves.

legend.lore: A night-black robe whose embroidered stars can be plucked and thrown.

capeMountebank.name: Cape of the Mountebank
capeMountebank.text: Each fight you start hidden: advantage on your first attack (and Sneak Attack).

legend.lore: A showman's cape that smells faintly of brimstone and applause.

animatedShield.name: Animated Shield
animatedShield.text: +2 AC while you hold no shield: it floats beside you, leaving both hands free.

legend.lore: A shield that guards on its own, so a greatsword need not choose.

ringRegeneration.name: Ring of Regeneration
ringRegeneration.text: Heal 4% of max HP at the start of each of your turns.

legend.lore: Its wearer's wounds close as you watch.

hundredFists.name: Gauntlets of the Hundred Fists
hundredFists.text: Unarmed strikes roll 1d10; +2 Focus for monks.

legend.lore: Fighting-school gauntlets that throw a hundred punches in the time it takes to blink.
Prayer beads of a saint who never let a friend fall.

hellfireContract.name: Hellfire Contract
hellfireContract.text: +12% damage and +1 spell save DC; −15% max HP.

legend.lore: Signed in blood. The fine print is written in fire.

hollowEye.name: Eye of the Hollow King
hollowEye.text: Crits on one lower face; +1 spell save DC; −10% max HP.

legend.lore: Plucked from a lich-king who saw everything and spared nothing.

robeArchmagi.name: Robe of the Archmagi
robeArchmagi.text: With no body armor your AC is 15 + DEX; +2 spell save DC and attack.

legend.lore: The robe of the highest office of magic. It protects as well as plate.

dragonOrb.name: Orb of Dragonkind
dragonOrb.text: Ember, Verdant, Shadow, Frost and Storm dice all count as your colour.

legend.lore: Five dragon souls swirl inside. They do not agree on anything, except you.

keen.name: Keen
keen.text: Critical hits on one lower face.

gilded.name: Gilded
gilded.text: +1 doubloon when you land a killing blow.

sootGoblin.name: Soot Goblin
sootGoblin.flavor: Quick hands, sooty grins, and a nose for your dice.

emberImp.name: Ember Imp
emberImp.flavor: A cackling spark with a grudge against good fortune.

slagHound.name: Slag Hound
slagHound.flavor: Its hide is cooling slag; its bite is not.

forgeAutomaton.name: Forge Automaton
forgeAutomaton.flavor: Built to guard the forge long after the smiths were gone.

ashCultist.name: Ash Cultist
ashCultist.flavor: Robed in grey, chanting to a furnace god.

forgemaster.name: The Forgemaster

boss.title: Warden of the Deep Forge
boss.intro: Bellows breathe. A giant of black iron lifts its hammer.

forgemaster.flavor: A colossal smith-engine that still keeps the forge lit.

ashHydra.name: Ash Hydra

boss.title: The Many-Throated
boss.intro: Five necks of cinder rise from the ash pit.

ashHydra.flavor: Every head you cut grows back hotter.

boundEmber.name: The Bound Ember

boss.title: Fire in Chains
boss.intro: Chained in runes, a living star strains against its prison.

boundEmber.flavor: A fire elemental chained beneath the vaults for an age.

sporeling.name: Sporeling
sporeling.flavor: Waddling mushrooms with a toxic sneeze.

mossWight.name: Moss Wight
mossWight.flavor: A mausoleum knight wrapped in moss and grave-roots.

thornSprite.name: Thorn Sprite
thornSprite.flavor: Giggling fey that think your luck is their toy.

vineStrangler.name: Vine Strangler
vineStrangler.flavor: The hallway is alive, and it wants to hug you.

fungalShaman.name: Fungal Shaman
fungalShaman.flavor: A myconid elder whose staff blooms with healing caps.

barkGolem.name: Bark Golem
barkGolem.flavor: Old oak shaped into a guardian by forgotten druids.

mycelialMonarch.name: The Mycelial Monarch

boss.title: Crown of the Undergrowth
boss.intro: The whole hall breathes spores. Something vast is thinking.

mycelialMonarch.flavor: A fungal intelligence that rules the halls from a throne of caps.

thornKnight.name: The Thorn Knight

boss.title: Oathsworn of the Briar
boss.intro: A knight in armour of living thorns lowers her lance.

thornKnight.flavor: A fey knight sworn to keep the dead asleep.

rootDragon.name: The Root Dragon

boss.title: The Hollow Wyrm
boss.intro: Roots uncoil into a serpentine shape. Bark-scales creak.

rootDragon.flavor: An ancient wyrm that became more tree than dragon.

inkEel.name: Ink Eel
inkEel.flavor: It swims through the drowned stacks in clouds of black ink.

drownedScribe.name: Drowned Scribe
drownedScribe.flavor: Still copying the same page it drowned writing.

brassCrab.name: Brass Crab
brassCrab.flavor: A clockwork librarian's guard, barnacled and furious.

tideCultist.name: Tide Cultist
tideCultist.flavor: Eel-cult priests who sing to the inverted tide.

glyphWisp.name: Glyph Wisp
glyphWisp.flavor: A loose letter of power, crackling between the shelves.

deepLurker.name: Deep Lurker
deepLurker.flavor: Something with too many arms lives in the reading pool.

drownedArchivist.name: The Drowned Archivist

boss.title: Keeper of Unwritten Things
boss.intro: Pages swirl in the black water. The Archivist turns to your chapter.

drownedArchivist.flavor: It has catalogued every death in the archive. Yours is next.

tideOracle.name: The Tide Oracle

boss.title: She Who Reads the Tide
boss.intro: The water rises upward. A blind oracle smiles at you.

tideOracle.flavor: A sea-witch who sees futures in reversed tides.

armoredLeviathan.name: The Armored Leviathan

boss.title: The Pump-Heart Beast
boss.intro: Pistons thunder. A whale of brass and barnacles surfaces.

armoredLeviathan.flavor: A great beast caged in brass to drive the archive's pumps.

shardStalker.name: Shard Stalker
shardStalker.flavor: A predator of broken glass that moves between reflections.

mirrorMimic.name: Mirror Mimic
mirrorMimic.flavor: It looks like you. Then it opens its mouth.

glassGolem.name: Glass Golem
glassGolem.flavor: A cathedral window that got up and walked.

prismSentinel.name: The Prism Sentinel

boss.title: Guardian of the Bright Nave
boss.intro: Light bends into a towering knight of crystal.

prismSentinel.flavor: The reliquary's last guardian, built of a thousand lenses.

shatteredDouble.name: The Shattered Double

boss.title: What the Mirror Kept
boss.intro: A cracked reflection steps out. It knows every hand you played.

shatteredDouble.flavor: Everything the mirrors ever stole, wearing your face.

glassSeraph.name: The Glass Seraph

boss.title: The Cracked Halo
boss.intro: Six wings of stained glass unfold. Silence falls.

glassSeraph.flavor: An angel of stained glass with a cracked halo.

graveSentinel.name: Grave Sentinel
graveSentinel.flavor: Skeletal guardians of the floating tombs.

voidMote.name: Void Mote
voidMote.flavor: A pinprick of nothing that eats light.

starboneHound.name: Starbone Hound
starboneHound.flavor: A hound of constellations, held together by old light.

cometCultist.name: Comet Cultist
cometCultist.flavor: They pray for the sky to fall again.

astralLeech.name: Astral Leech
astralLeech.flavor: It feeds on luck, then on blood.

orbitWarden.name: Orbit Warden
orbitWarden.flavor: A brass orrery that commands gravity.

astralJudge.name: The Astral Judge

boss.title: Arbiter of the Fallen Sky
boss.intro: A skeletal judge in robes of night raises a gavel of starlight.

astralJudge.flavor: It weighs every soul that falls from the sky.

fallenComet.name: The Fallen Comet

boss.title: The Burning Visitor
boss.intro: The ceiling is gone. A comet with a mind stares down.

fallenComet.flavor: A star that fell and did not die.

epochDevourer.name: The Epoch Devourer

boss.title: That Which Ends Ages
boss.intro: Time goes thin. Something that eats eras uncurls.

epochDevourer.flavor: It ate the civilisation that built the ossuary. It is still hungry.

cinderGiant.name: Cinder Giant
cinderGiant.flavor: The forge-tenders the smiths were afraid of.

pyreDrake.name: Pyre Drake
pyreDrake.flavor: A lean drake that nests in the bellows and breathes the forge's heat.

blightTreant.name: Blight Treant
blightTreant.flavor: A rotting oak-warden that still remembers its oath.

briarHag.name: Briar Hag
briarHag.flavor: She trades in luck and pays in thorns.

krakenSpawn.name: Kraken Spawn
krakenSpawn.flavor: Young, hungry, and already too big for the reading pool.

sunkenLich.name: Sunken Lich
sunkenLich.flavor: A scholar who chose the water over forgetting.

mirrorKnight.name: Mirror Knight
mirrorKnight.flavor: Armour polished so long it forgot there was a knight inside.

facetArchon.name: Facet Archon
facetArchon.flavor: An angel of the reliquary, cut like a jewel.

nebulaWraith.name: Nebula Wraith
nebulaWraith.flavor: A dead astronomer, now mostly the dark between stars.

starwyrm.name: Starwyrm
starwyrm.flavor: A serpent that coils in orbit and breathes falling stars.

tiamat.name: Tiamat

boss.title: the Dragon Queen
boss.intro: Five heads rise above the hoard. Each breathes a different death.

tiamat.flavor: The five-headed Dragon Queen, sealed behind the Sixth Door for an age, and awake again.

uncannyDodge.name: Uncanny Dodge
uncannyDodge.text: Halves the first hit it takes each round.

retaliate.name: Retaliation
retaliate.text: Strikes back at anyone who hits it in melee.

deathburst.name: Death Burst
deathburst.text: Explodes when it dies, hurting the front rank.

pack.name: Pack Tactics
pack.text: Advantage on attacks while an ally stands in its rank.

lair.name: Lair Actions
lair.text: The lair itself strikes at the top of every round.

relentless.name: Relentless
relentless.text: Often strikes twice in a turn.

rayOfFrost.name: Ray of Frost
rayOfFrost.text: Ranged spell attack: 1d8 cold; the target is slowed.

shockingGrasp.name: Shocking Grasp
shockingGrasp.text: Melee spell attack: 1d8 lightning; the target loses its reaction.

chillTouch.name: Chill Touch
chillTouch.text: Melee spell attack: 1d10 necrotic; the target cannot regain HP.

tollTheDead.name: Toll the Dead
tollTheDead.text: WIS save or take 1d8 necrotic (1d12 if the target is wounded).

eldritchBlast.name: Eldritch Blast
eldritchBlast.text: One beam (more at 5, 11, 17): ranged spell attack, 1d10 force each.

viciousMockery.name: Vicious Mockery
viciousMockery.text: WIS save or 1d6 psychic and disadvantage on its next attack.

starryWisp.name: Starry Wisp
starryWisp.text: Ranged spell attack: 1d8 radiant; the target glows (attacks against it have advantage).

produceFlame.name: Produce Flame
produceFlame.text: Ranged spell attack: 1d8 fire. Lights dark rooms.

thornWhip.name: Thorn Whip
thornWhip.text: Melee-range spell attack at any rank: 1d6 piercing; pulls a back-rank target to the front.

light.name: Light
light.text: Exploration: illuminates dark rooms and reveals clues.

guidance.name: Guidance
guidance.text: Exploration: +1d4 to the next skill check.

magicMissile.name: Magic Missile
magicMissile.text: Three darts that never miss: 3d4+3 force.

burningHands.name: Burning Hands
burningHands.text: A rank of foes: DEX save, 3d6 fire (half on success).

thunderwave.name: Thunderwave
thunderwave.text: A rank of foes: CON save, 2d8 thunder; failures are pushed back.

chromaticOrb.name: Chromatic Orb
chromaticOrb.text: Ranged spell attack: 3d8 of the element the target is weakest to.

iceKnife.name: Ice Knife
iceKnife.text: Ranged attack 1d10 piercing, then the target's rank makes a DEX save vs 2d6 cold.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.text: A rank of foes: WIS save or fall asleep (damage wakes them).

shield.name: Shield
shield.text: Adapted: +5 AC until your next turn (cast as a bonus action).

healingWord.name: Healing Word
healingWord.text: Bonus Action: heal 2d4 + casting modifier at range — can lift a downed ally.

guidingBolt.name: Guiding Bolt
guidingBolt.text: Ranged spell attack: 4d6 radiant; the next attack against the target has advantage.

bless.name: Bless
bless.text: The party adds 1d4 to attack rolls and saves.

bane.name: Bane
bane.text: Up to three foes: CHA save or subtract 1d4 from attacks and saves.

inflictWounds.name: Inflict Wounds
inflictWounds.text: Touch: CON save, 2d10 necrotic (half on success).

command.name: Command

sharpshooter.name: Sharpshooter
sharpshooter.text: Ranged attacks ignore cover and can strike the back rank freely; +1 DEX.

warCaster.name: War Caster
warCaster.text: Advantage on concentration saves; +1 casting score.

defensiveDuelist.name: Defensive Duelist
defensiveDuelist.text: Reaction: +PB AC against one melee attack each round.

healer.name: Healer
healer.text: Healing potions and kits you use restore extra HP equal to your level.

magicInitiate.name: Magic Initiate
magicInitiate.text: Learn two cantrips and a 1st-level spell (Cure Wounds).

manyHands.name: Many Hands (Human)
manyHands.text: Humans learn a bit of everything: +1 to any ability, proficiency in Athletics, and +1 skill trick per fight.

lanternBearer.name: Lantern Bearer (Human)
lanternBearer.text: +1 CON or WIS and +1 initiative. You pack a Tonic Coin for every expedition.

moonlitStep.name: Moonlit Step (Elf)
moonlitStep.text: +1 DEX or WIS. You start each fight hidden (advantage on your first attack).

starsong.name: Starsong (Elf)
starsong.text: +1 DEX, INT or CHA. Straights and Straight Sets you play get +2 Mult.

forgeBlooded.name: Forge-Blooded (Dwarf)
forgeBlooded.text: +1 STR or CON, resistance to fire, and +5% max HP.

stoneTally.name: Stone Tally (Dwarf)
stoneTally.text: Dwarves count in threes: +1 CON or WIS, and Three and Four of a Kind hands you play get +2 Mult.

secondBreakfast.name: Second Breakfast (Halfling)
secondBreakfast.text: +1 CON or DEX. Healing you receive is 20% stronger.

pocketfulOfLuck.name: Pocketful of Luck (Halfling)
pocketfulOfLuck.text: +1 DEX or CHA. You start each expedition with a Mulligan Coin and a Fate Coin.

hoardSense.name: Hoard Sense (Dragonborn)
hoardSense.text: +1 STR or CHA. Full House and Dragon Hoard hands you play get +3 Mult.

tinkersKnack.name: Tinker's Knack (Gnome)
tinkersKnack.text: +1 INT or DEX, proficiency in Sleight of Hand, and +1 skill trick per fight.

clockworkOdds.name: Clockwork Odds (Gnome)
clockworkOdds.text: +1 INT. Each fight opens with a Wild die on the tray.

mountainborn.name: Mountainborn (Goliath)
mountainborn.text: +1 STR or CON, resistance to cold, and you can't be knocked prone.

giantsGrip.name: Giant's Grip (Goliath)
giantsGrip.text: +1 STR and +1 to hit and damage with weapons.

bloodFury.name: Blood Fury (Orc)
bloodFury.text: +1 STR or CON. While at or below half HP you deal 15% more damage.

trophyTaker.name: Trophy Taker (Orc)
trophyTaker.text: +1 STR or WIS. Each kill heals you 6% of your max HP.

hellfireBlood.name: Hellfire Blood (Tiefling)
hellfireBlood.text: +1 CON or CHA. Melee attackers that hit you take fire damage equal to your level.

devilsBargain.name: Devil's Bargain (Tiefling)
devilsBargain.text: +1 CHA or INT. Shadow and ember dice count as your colour (+1 Mult each when scored).

combatProwess.name: Boon of Combat Prowess
combatProwess.text: Once per turn, turn a missed attack into a hit.

fate.name: Boon of Fate
fate.text: +1 tray size and +1 reroll on your turns.

spellRecall.name: Boon of Spell Recall
spellRecall.text: One free 1st–4th level spell per rest.

human.name: Human
human.text: Resourceful and skilled: an extra skill and an extra reroll at the start of each expedition.

elf.name: Elf
elf.text: Keen senses (Perception) and fey ancestry (advantage against charm).

dwarf.name: Dwarf
dwarf.text: Dwarven toughness (+1 HP per level) and poison resistance.

halfling.name: Halfling
halfling.text: Luck: a natural 1 on an attack or save is rerolled. Brave against fear.

dragonborn.name: Dragonborn
dragonborn.text: Breath Weapon (1d10 per tier, DEX save, a whole rank) and fire resistance.

gnome.name: Gnome
gnome.text: Gnomish cunning: advantage on INT, WIS and CHA saves.

goliath.name: Goliath
goliath.text: Stone's Endurance: reduce a hit by 1d12 + CON, PB times per rest.

orc.name: Orc
orc.text: Relentless Endurance: once per long rest drop to 1 HP instead of 0.

tiefling.name: Tiefling
tiefling.text: Infernal legacy: fire resistance and the Fire Bolt cantrip.

criminal.name: Criminal
criminal.text: Knows the underside of every city.

sleightOfHand.name: Palm
sleightOfHand.text: Swap a die for the next one in the bag.

arcana.name: Attune
arcana.text: A die becomes your colour (same value).

history.name: Precedent
history.text: Set a die to the most common value on the tray.

investigation.name: Deduce
investigation.text: Swap a die for the best of the next 3 in the bag.

nature.name: Weathersense
nature.text: Reroll every 1 and 2 on the tray for free.

animalHandling.name: Fetch
animalHandling.text: Draw one extra die onto the tray.

medicine.name: Mend
medicine.text: Clear every jinx on the tray and lift cursed faces.

perception.name: Spot
perception.text: A die's face turns Keen (+6 chips).

religion.name: Prayer
religion.text: Your next hand this turn gains +2 Mult.

survival.name: Make Do
survival.text: A die showing 1 or 2 becomes a 5.

intimidation.name: Menace
intimidation.text: Your next hand this turn gains +1 Mult per living foe.

performance.name: Showstopper
performance.text: Your next hand this turn: ×1.5 Mult if it is a Straight or better.

persuasion.name: Rally
persuasion.text: Copy a die onto the tray.

bone.name: Bone
bone.text: Plain old bone. No special effect.

glass.name: Glass
glass.text: When scored: ×2 mult. 1 in 4 chance to shatter.

lead.name: Lead
lead.text: Loaded: rolls twice and keeps the higher face.

twinned.name: Twinned Die
twinned.text: Only threes and fours. Pairs come easy.

snake.name: Snake Die
snake.text: Ones and sixes — feast or famine.

ladder.name: Ladder Die
ladder.text: Built for straights. One wild face.

goldbug.name: Goldbug Die
goldbug.text: Gold die with three gilded faces.

prism.name: Prism Die
prism.text: Counts as every material — Sets love it.

starseed.name: Starseed Die
starseed.text: Prism die with a wild face.

pair.name: Pair
pair.blurb: Two dice showing the same value.

three.name: Three of a Kind
three.blurb: Three dice showing the same value.

straight.name: Straight
straight.blurb: Five dice in an unbroken run.

set.name: Set
set.blurb: Five dice of the same material.

fullHouse.name: Full House
fullHouse.blurb: A Three of a Kind and a Pair.

four.name: Four of a Kind
four.blurb: Four dice showing the same value.

straightSet.name: Straight Set
straightSet.blurb: A Straight made of one material.

five.name: Five of a Kind
five.blurb: All five dice the same. The Treasure.

fullSet.name: Full Set
fullSet.blurb: A Full House of one material.

hoard.name: Dragon Hoard
hoard.blurb: Five of a Kind of one material.

ashen.name: Ashen Pall
ashen.text: Dice showing 1 or 2 are debuffed (score nothing).

molten.name: Molten Seal
molten.text: Steel and Ember dice are debuffed.

thorns.name: Thorned Cup
thorns.text: Each reroll costs the acting hero 4% of max HP.

void.name: The Unwritten
void.text: Omens are ignored: every hand scores at Lv.1.

gravity.name: Crushing Weight
gravity.text: Dice showing 5 or more are debuffed.

chromatic.name: Chromatic Dominion
chromatic.text: Ember, Verdant, Shadow, Frost and Storm dice are debuffed, and Mult is ×0.75.

judgement.name: Judgement
judgement.text: Playing the same hand type twice in a row scores ×0.5.

twinFang.name: Twin Fang
twinFang.text: +5 Mult if the hand contains a Pair.

tripleCrown.name: Triple Crown
tripleCrown.text: +8 Mult if the hand contains Three of a Kind.

ladderOfBones.name: Ladder of Bones
ladderOfBones.text: +8 Mult if the hand contains a Straight.

guildmark.name: Guildmark
guildmark.text: +7 Mult if the hand contains a Set.

pebblePouch.name: Pebble Pouch
pebblePouch.text: +16 Chips if the hand contains Two Pair.

whetstone.name: Whetstone
whetstone.text: +20 Chips if 3 or fewer dice are played.

lastLaugh.name: Last Laugh
lastLaugh.text: +10 Mult if the acting hero is below half HP.

kinship.name: Kinship Band
kinship.text: Scored dice matching the hero's affinity give +1 extra Mult.

bloodstone.name: Bloodstone
bloodstone.text: Gains +1 Mult whenever an enemy dies. (Currently +{n})

dragonLedger.name: Dragon's Ledger
dragonLedger.text: +1 Mult for every 3 doubloons you hold.

crookedLadder.name: Crooked Ladder
crookedLadder.text: Straights and Sets can be made with 4 dice.

weightedFate.name: Weighted Fate
weightedFate.text: +2 to hit on all attack rolls.

butchersHook.name: Butcher's Hook
butchersHook.text: Overkill from a single-target hit carries half into the next foe.

hawkMonocle.name: Hawk's Monocle
hawkMonocle.text: Critical hits on one lower d20 face.

luckySeven.name: Lucky Seven
luckySeven.text: ×3 Mult if scored pips total a multiple of 7.

snowball.name: Rolling Snowball
snowball.text: Gains +3 Chips each time a Pair is played. (Currently +{n})

paritySeal.name: Parity Seal
paritySeal.text: ×1.5 Mult if all scored dice are odd, or all even.

magpie.name: Magpie Nest
magpie.text: Scored Gold dice give +2 more doubloons.

echoBell.name: Echo Bell
echoBell.text: The first scored die triggers twice.

hourglass.name: Sandglass
hourglass.text: ×2 Mult on the first hand of each combat.

quarrymark.name: Quarry Sigil
quarrymark.text: ×1.5 Mult against a Marked or Hexed target.

pocketSun.name: Pocket Sun
pocketSun.text: +3 Mult per scored Sun or Ember die.

nightOwl.name: Night Owl
nightOwl.text: +3 Mult per scored Shadow or Arcane die.

ironRoot.name: Iron Root
ironRoot.text: +3 Mult per scored Steel, Verdant, Storm or Blood die.

tyrantCrown.name: Tyrant's Crown
tyrantCrown.text: ×2 Mult on Four of a Kind or better.

twinSuns.name: Twin Suns
twinSuns.text: ×2 Mult if the hand contains Two Pair.

glassHeart.name: Glass Heart
glassHeart.text: ×3 Mult. The acting hero loses 5% max HP per hand.

ouroboros.name: Ouroboros Ring
ouroboros.text: Gains ×0.1 Mult per hand played this run. (Currently ×{n})

paupersCrown.name: Pauper's Crown
paupersCrown.text: ×2.5 Mult while you hold fewer than 5 doubloons.

monolith.name: Monolith
monolith.text: A single played die scores as Three of a Kind.

prismLens.name: Prismatic Lens
prismLens.text: Every die counts as every material.

mimicTongue.name: Mimic Tongue
mimicTongue.text: Copies the charm to its right.

avalanche.name: Avalanche Idol
avalanche.text: Gains ×0.25 Mult each combat won without a hero falling. Resets if one falls. (Currently ×{n})

starEater.name: Star-Eater Fang
starEater.text: Scored dice of 5 or higher give ×1.25 Mult.

idol_steel.name: Anvil Idol
idol_steel.text: Scored Steel dice give +3 Chips and +2 Mult.

idol_sun.name: Dawn Idol
idol_sun.text: Scored Sun dice give +3 Chips and +2 Mult.

idol_shadow.name: Dusk Idol
idol_shadow.text: Scored Shadow dice give +3 Chips and +2 Mult.

idol_ember.name: Pyre Idol
idol_ember.text: Scored Ember dice give +3 Chips and +2 Mult.

idol_verdant.name: Thorn Idol
idol_verdant.text: Scored Verdant dice give +3 Chips and +2 Mult.

idol_arcane.name: Sigil Idol
idol_arcane.text: Scored Arcane dice give +3 Chips and +2 Mult.

idol_blood.name: Fury Idol
idol_blood.text: Scored Blood dice give +3 Chips and +2 Mult.

idol_storm.name: Gale Idol
idol_storm.text: Scored Storm dice give +3 Chips and +2 Mult.

mulligan.name: Mulligan Coin
mulligan.text: Reroll your whole tray for free.

fateCoin.name: Fate Coin
fateCoin.text: Turn one tray die to any face it has.

loadedCoin.name: Loaded Coin
loadedCoin.text: Your next attack roll is a natural 20.

encore.name: Encore Coin
encore.text: The acting hero may play a second hand this turn.

tonic.name: Tonic Coin
tonic.text: Heal the acting hero for 30% of max HP.

handSize.name: Wider Tray
handSize.text: +1 tray size for the rest of this run.

rerolls.name: Steady Wrist
rerolls.text: +1 reroll every turn for the rest of this run.

charmSlot.name: Charm Hook
charmSlot.text: +1 charm slot for the rest of this run.

chisel.name: Mason's Chisel
chisel.text: Raise every face of one die by 1 except its highest (max 9).

loaded.name: Loaded
loaded.text: Rolls twice and keeps the higher face.

kindred.name: Kindred
kindred.text: +2 Mult when its owner plays it.

echoing.name: Echoing
echoing.text: Scores twice when its owner plays it.

steadfast.name: Steadfast
steadfast.text: Can't be jinxed, stolen or cursed.

eager.name: Eager
eager.text: Always lands in the opening tray.

guild.name: Guild Hall
guild.text: More recruits to choose from and a bigger roster.

enchanter.name: Enchanter
enchanter.text: Higher enchantment caps (+1 per level, max +3).

difficulties.explorer: Softer foes and a gentler climb; slightly less gold. A good first legacy.
difficulties.standard: The intended challenge: real fights from the first door to the last, and heroes can die.
difficulties.perilous: More foes, tougher fights, cursed elites, ×1.5 gold. Better loot, +1 bonus magic item for beating the boss.
difficulties.deadly: Brutal: much tougher foes, crowded boss lairs, cursed elites, ×2 gold. Much better loot, +2 bonus magic items for beating the boss. Expect funerals.

weaponMastery.name: Weapon Mastery
weaponMastery.text: Use the mastery property of your equipped weapon (Cleave, Graze, Nick, Push, Sap, Slow, Topple, Vex).

asi.name: Ability Score Improvement
asi.text: Raise one score by 2 or two by 1 (max 20), or take a feat.

extraAttack.name: Extra Attack
extraAttack.text: Attack 2 times whenever you take the Attack action.

extraAttack2.name: Two Extra Attacks
extraAttack2.text: Attack 3 times whenever you take the Attack action.

extraAttack3.name: Three Extra Attacks
extraAttack3.text: Attack 4 times whenever you take the Attack action.

subclass.name: Subclass
subclass.text: Choose your subclass. It adds its own features at levels 3 and up.

2,4.name: Cellar Stair
2,4.text: Steps lead down from the Lantern Keep into the training cellar. The Keep keeps it stocked with soot goblins for practice. Mostly.

2,3.name: Ash Tunnel
2,3.text: Ash drifts like grey snow. Somewhere ahead, a goblin is counting stolen dice out loud, badly.

2,2.name: Smelting Floor
2,2.text: Two soot goblins look up from a pile of dice. They do not look pleased to see you.

1,2.name: Smith's Hoard
1,2.text: A dented strongbox sits under a workbench. Somebody forgot to lock it.

2,1.name: Sigil Kiln
2,1.text: A sigil-key glows on a plinth. The door beyond it is sealed with the same mark.

2,0.name: The Practice Forge
2,0.text: An old forge-engine, kept running as a sparring partner, lifts its hammer. Today it is set to "gentle".

tutorial.name: The Training Cellar
tutorial.objective: take the Boss Sigil and beat the practice forge

berserker.name: Path of the Berserker
berserker.summary: Fury for its own sake: extra damage while raging recklessly, and nothing can scare you out of it.

frenzy.name: Frenzy
frenzy.text: While Raging and Reckless, your first hit each turn deals extra d6s equal to your rage damage.

mindlessRage.name: Mindless Rage
mindlessRage.text: While Raging you are immune to charmed and frightened.

retaliation.name: Retaliation
retaliation.text: When a melee attack damages you, strike back with your reaction.

intimidatingPresence.name: Intimidating Presence
intimidatingPresence.text: Bonus Action, once per long rest: enemies make a WIS save or are frightened.

ancestralGuardian.name: Path of the Ancestral Guardian
ancestralGuardian.summary: Spirits of your ancestors stand guard over your companions and punish anyone who strikes you.

ancestralProtectors.name: Ancestral Protectors
ancestralProtectors.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: spectral warriors close around the party. Every ally gains +2 AC for 2 rounds.

spiritShield.name: Spirit Shield
spiritShield.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: the spirits wrap every ally in a ward of temporary HP equal to half your level (×vitality).

consultTheSpirits.name: Consult the Spirits
consultTheSpirits.text: Your ancestors whisper about what lies ahead: +1 skill trick per fight.

vengefulAncestors.name: Vengeful Ancestors
vengefulAncestors.text: A melee attacker that hits you takes force damage equal to twice your level.

battlerager.name: Path of the Battlerager
battlerager.summary: A dwarf-born brawler in spiked armour who turns every embrace into a wound.

battleragerArmor.name: Battlerager Armor
battleragerArmor.text: Your spiked armour bites: your weapon hits add 1d4 piercing, and a melee attacker that hits you takes piercing damage equal to your level.

recklessAbandon.name: Reckless Abandon
recklessAbandon.text: Pain only feeds you: regain 2% of your max HP at the start of each of your turns.

spikedRetribution.name: Spiked Retribution
spikedRetribution.text: Your spikes grow longer: melee attackers that hit you take another hit of piercing damage equal to your level.

beast.name: Path of the Beast
beast.summary: Claws, fangs and a tail burst out when you rage: a predator that feeds on the fight.

formOfTheBeast.name: Form of the Beast
formOfTheBeast.text: Your weapon hits add 1d4 piercing from claws and fangs, and you heal 5% of the damage you deal with weapons.

bestialSoul.name: Bestial Soul
bestialSoul.text: Your body adapts to any hunt: +2 initiative and proficiency in Athletics (and its tray trick).

infectiousFury.name: Infectious Fury
infectiousFury.text: Attack action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: your first hit adds 2d12 psychic and the target makes a Wisdom save or is charmed into confusion for 1 round.

callTheHunt.name: Call the Hunt
callTheHunt.text: Bonus Action, Constitution modifier times per long rest: the whole party catches your bloodlust. Allies deal +1d4 radiant on hits for 10 rounds.

giant.name: Path of the Giant
giant.summary: The strength of giants swells your frame and charges your weapon with elemental force.

giantsHavoc.name: Giant's Power and Havoc
giantsHavoc.text: You grow huge in a fight: weapon hits add 1d4 thunder, and you gain proficiency in Athletics.

elementalCleaver.name: Elemental Cleaver
elementalCleaver.text: Your weapon burns with elemental power: weapon hits add 1d6 fire.

mightyImpel.name: Mighty Impel
mightyImpel.text: Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: hurl a foe. It takes 2d6 + Strength bludgeoning (Strength save halves) and falls prone.

demiurgicColossus.name: Demiurgic Colossus
demiurgicColossus.text: You become a true giant: Elemental Cleaver adds another 1d6, and your max HP rises by 10%.

juggernaut.name: Path of the Juggernaut
juggernaut.summary: An unstoppable force: every blow shakes the ground and nothing knocks you down.

thunderousBlows.name: Thunderous Blows
thunderousBlows.text: Your blows land like falling stones: weapon hits add 1d4 thunder, and overkill from your melee hits carries into the next foe.

spiritOfTheMountain.name: Spirit of the Mountain
spiritOfTheMountain.text: You can't be knocked prone or restrained.

demolishingMight.name: Demolishing Might
demolishingMight.text: You break what others can't: +15% damage against elites and bosses.

unstoppable.name: Unstoppable
unstoppable.text: Nothing slows your advance: you can't be frightened, stunned or slowed.

stormHerald.name: Path of the Storm Herald
stormHerald.summary: Your rage is a storm: lightning leaps from you and the weather shields your friends.

stormAura.name: Storm Aura
stormAura.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per short rest: lightning leaps to one foe for 2d6 lightning (Dexterity save halves).

stormSoul.name: Storm Soul
stormSoul.text: Resistance to lightning and cold damage.

shieldingStorm.name: Shielding Storm
shieldingStorm.text: The storm turns aside the worst of the elements: resistance to fire and thunder, and +1 to all saving throws.

ragingStorm.name: Raging Storm
ragingStorm.text: A melee attacker that hits you is struck by lightning for twice your level.

totemWarrior.name: Path of the Totem Warrior
totemWarrior.summary: A spirit animal guides you: the bear's toughness, the eagle's sight and the wolf's pack.

totemSpirit.name: Totem Spirit (Bear)
totemSpirit.text: The bear spirit makes you hard to hurt: resistance to cold, fire, lightning and poison.

aspectOfTheBeast.name: Aspect of the Beast (Eagle)
aspectOfTheBeast.text: You see danger from far away: +2 initiative and proficiency in Perception.

spiritWalker.name: Spirit Walker
spiritWalker.text: Animal spirits answer your questions: +1 skill trick per fight.

totemicAttunement.name: Totemic Attunement (Wolf)
totemicAttunement.text: You hunt as a pack: Two Pair and Full House hands you play get +3 Mult.

zealot.name: Path of the Zealot
zealot.summary: A god's chosen warrior: holy fury in every blow, and death itself has to wait.

divineFury.name: Divine Fury
divineFury.text: Your weapon hits add 1d6 radiant. Healing you receive is 20% stronger (Warrior of the Gods).

fanaticalFocus.name: Fanatical Focus
fanaticalFocus.text: Your faith steadies you: +1 to all saving throws.

zealousPresence.name: Zealous Presence
zealousPresence.text: Bonus Action, once per long rest: a battle cry blesses every ally for 3 rounds (+1d4 to attacks and saves).

rageBeyondDeath.name: Rage Beyond Death
rageBeyondDeath.text: The first time you would drop to 0 HP in a fight, you stay at 1 HP instead.

wildMagic.name: Path of Wild Magic
wildMagic.summary: Raw magic sparks off your rage. It is unpredictable, but it loves the dice.

wildSurge.name: Magic Awareness and Wild Surge
wildSurge.text: Wild magic follows you into every fight: each fight opens with a Wild die on the tray.

bolsteringMagic.name: Bolstering Magic
bolsteringMagic.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: touch an ally to bless them for 10 rounds (+1d4 to attacks and saves).

unstableBacklash.name: Unstable Backlash
unstableBacklash.text: Magic crackles whenever you act: +1 reroll on each of your turns.

controlledSurge.name: Controlled Surge
controlledSurge.text: You steer the chaos: each fight opens with another Wild die, and Five of a Kind hands you play are scored ×1.5.

lore.name: College of Lore
lore.summary: Collectors of every song and secret: sharp words that throw off a foe, and skills no one else has.

cuttingWords.name: Cutting Words
cuttingWords.text: Reaction: when an ally is hit, spend Inspiration to reduce the damage by your Inspiration die.

magicalDiscoveries.name: Magical Discoveries
magicalDiscoveries.text: Learn spells from any list (Cleric, Druid or Wizard).

peerlessSkill.name: Peerless Skill
peerlessSkill.text: Add an Inspiration die to failed checks.

creation.name: College of Creation
creation.summary: You sing the first song that shaped the world, and small things come alive to help.

noteOfPotential.name: Note of Potential
noteOfPotential.text: Your inspiration hums with the song of creation: Straights you play get +3 Mult.

performanceOfCreation.name: Performance of Creation
performanceOfCreation.text: You can sing a small useful object into being: +1 skill trick per fight.

animatingPerformance.name: Animating Performance
animatingPerformance.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: an animated object slams one foe for 2d10 + Charisma force.

creativeCrescendo.name: Creative Crescendo
creativeCrescendo.text: Your creations multiply: +2 Bardic Inspiration uses and +1 skill trick per fight.

eloquence.name: College of Eloquence
eloquence.summary: A master orator: your words are always persuasive and your mockery takes the fight out of foes.

silverTongue.name: Silver Tongue
silverTongue.text: Proficiency in Deception and Persuasion, each with +3.

unsettlingWords.name: Unsettling Words
unsettlingWords.text: Bonus Action, spend a Bardic Inspiration: one foe is baned for 3 rounds (−1d4 to attacks and saves).

unfailingInspiration.name: Unfailing Inspiration
unfailingInspiration.text: Your inspiration rarely goes to waste: +1 Bardic Inspiration use. You also speak so that anyone can understand you.

infectiousInspiration.name: Infectious Inspiration
infectiousInspiration.text: Good advice spreads: +2 Bardic Inspiration uses, and Pairs and Two Pairs you play get +2 Mult.

glamour.name: College of Glamour
glamour.summary: Fey beauty and command: allies stand taller in your presence, and enemies forget to fight.

mantleOfInspiration.name: Mantle of Inspiration
mantleOfInspiration.text: Bonus Action, spend a Bardic Inspiration: every ally gains temporary HP equal to half your level (×vitality).

mantleOfMajesty.name: Mantle of Majesty
mantleOfMajesty.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: command one foe. It makes a Wisdom save or is charmed for 1 round.

unbreakableMajesty.name: Unbreakable Majesty
unbreakableMajesty.text: Foes hesitate to strike you: the first hit you take each fight deals nothing, and +1 to all saving throws.

spirits.name: College of Spirits
spirits.summary: You channel the stories of the dead through candles, skulls and tarot.

spiritualFocus.name: Guiding Whispers and Spiritual Focus
spiritualFocus.text: Spirits steady your magic: +2 to your spell damage rolls, and healing you give is 10% stronger.

talesFromBeyond.name: Tales from Beyond
talesFromBeyond.text: Action, proficiency bonus times per short rest: a spirit tells a terrible tale to one foe for 2d6 + Charisma psychic.

spiritSession.name: Spirit Session
spiritSession.text: The dead share what they knew: proficiency in History and Religion, and +1 skill trick per fight.

mysticalConnection.name: Mystical Connection
mysticalConnection.text: The spirits tilt fate your way: +1 reroll on each of your turns.

swords.name: College of Swords
swords.summary: Blade-dancing entertainers whose flourishes are as deadly as they are pretty.

swordsTraining.name: Bonus Proficiencies
swordsTraining.text: Proficiency with martial weapons and medium armour.

bladeFlourish.name: Blade Flourish
bladeFlourish.text: Attack action, spend a Bardic Inspiration: your first hit adds 1d8 and the flourish keeps a foe off balance (it is weakened for 1 round).

extraAttack.name: Extra Attack
extraAttack.text: Attack twice whenever you take the Attack action.

mastersFlourish.name: Master's Flourish
mastersFlourish.text: Flourishes come easily now: +3 Bardic Inspiration uses, and your crits land on 19–20.

valor.name: College of Valor
valor.summary: Skalds who sing the deeds of heroes, then fight beside them.

valorTraining.name: Bonus Proficiencies
valorTraining.text: Proficiency with martial weapons, medium armour and shields.

combatInspiration.name: Combat Inspiration
combatInspiration.text: Bonus Action, spend a Bardic Inspiration: one ally strikes harder for 3 rounds (+1d4 radiant on hits).

extraAttack.name: Extra Attack
extraAttack.text: Attack twice whenever you take the Attack action.

battleMagic.name: Battle Magic
battleMagic.text: Spell and steel flow together: +10% to all your damage.

whispers.name: College of Whispers
whispers.summary: Spies who sell secrets, wear stolen faces and cut with psychic blades.

psychicBlades.name: Psychic Blades
psychicBlades.text: Attack action, spend a Bardic Inspiration: your first hit adds 2d6 psychic.

mantleOfWhispers.name: Mantle of Whispers
mantleOfWhispers.text: You wear a borrowed face into every fight: you start each fight hidden (advantage on your first attack).

shadowLore.name: Shadow Lore
shadowLore.text: Action, once per long rest: whisper a foe's worst secret. It makes a Wisdom save or is charmed for 2 rounds.

life.name: Life Domain
life.summary: The god of healing works through you: every spell that mends mends more.

discipleOfLife.name: Disciple of Life
discipleOfLife.text: Healing spells restore 2 + spell level extra HP.

preserveLife.name: Preserve Life
preserveLife.text: Channel Divinity: restore 5 × level HP split among wounded allies.

blessedHealer.name: Blessed Healer
blessedHealer.text: Healing an ally also heals you for 2 + spell level.

supremeHealing.name: Supreme Healing
supremeHealing.text: Healing dice always roll their maximum.

arcana.name: Arcana Domain
arcana.summary: A god of magic itself: you study spells like a wizard and banish things that should not be here.

arcaneInitiate.name: Arcane Initiate
arcaneInitiate.text: Proficiency in Arcana, and +1 to your spell damage rolls.

arcaneAbjuration.name: Channel Divinity: Arcane Abjuration
arcaneAbjuration.text: Action, spend Channel Divinity: one foe makes a Charisma save or is banished for 1 round.

spellBreaker.name: Spell Breaker
spellBreaker.text: Your healing also breaks hostile magic: healing you give is 10% stronger, and +1 to all saving throws.

arcaneMastery.name: Arcane Mastery
arcaneMastery.text: You add wizard spells of great power to your prayers: one extra 6th-level and one extra 8th-level slot.

blood.name: Blood Domain
blood.summary: Blood is life, and you know how to take it: a priest who binds foes through their veins.

bloodlettingAura.name: Bloodletting Aura
bloodlettingAura.text: Proficiency with martial weapons, and your weapon hits add 1d4 necrotic.

crimsonBond.name: Channel Divinity: Crimson Bond
crimsonBond.text: Action, spend Channel Divinity: one foe makes a Constitution save or takes 2d6 necrotic and can't heal for 2 rounds.

sanguineRecall.name: Sanguine Recall
sanguineRecall.text: You draw power from your own blood: one extra 1st-level and one extra 2nd-level slot.

vascularCorruptionAura.name: Vascular Corruption Aura
vascularCorruptionAura.text: Your blood turns on those who wound you: melee attackers that hit you take necrotic damage equal to twice your level.

death.name: Death Domain
death.summary: A priest of endings who wields necrotic power the way others wield light.

reaper.name: Reaper
reaper.text: Proficiency with martial weapons, and +2 to your spell damage rolls.

touchOfDeath.name: Channel Divinity: Touch of Death
touchOfDeath.text: Attack action, spend Channel Divinity: your first hit adds 1d10 + your level in necrotic damage.

inescapableDestruction.name: Inescapable Destruction
inescapableDestruction.text: Your necrotic power cuts through defences: +2 more to your spell damage rolls.

improvedReaper.name: Improved Reaper
improvedReaper.text: Death answers you readily: +8% to all your damage, and +3 to your spell damage rolls.

forge.name: Forge Domain
forge.summary: A smith-priest who blesses steel, wears heavy plate and stands unharmed in fire.

blessingOfTheForge.name: Blessing of the Forge
blessingOfTheForge.text: Your gear is forge-blessed: +1 AC, +1 to hit and damage with weapons, and training with heavy armour.

artisansBlessing.name: Channel Divinity: Artisan's Blessing
artisansBlessing.text: You can forge simple metal tools and keys: proficiency in Sleight of Hand.

saintOfForgeAndFire.name: Saint of Forge and Fire
saintOfForgeAndFire.text: Fire can't touch you and steel barely does: your max HP rises by 10% and your AC by 1.

grave.name: Grave Domain
grave.summary: A guardian of the line between life and death: you keep friends on this side and mark foes for the other.

circleOfMortality.name: Circle of Mortality
circleOfMortality.text: Healing you give is 20% stronger. You can also sense the undead (Eyes of the Grave).

pathToTheGrave.name: Channel Divinity: Path to the Grave
pathToTheGrave.text: Action, spend Channel Divinity: curse one foe. It is vulnerable (takes +25% damage) for 2 rounds.

sentinelAtDeathsDoor.name: Sentinel at Death's Door
sentinelAtDeathsDoor.text: Bonus Action, Wisdom modifier times per long rest: shield an ally from a killing blow. They gain +5 AC until your next turn.

keeperOfSouls.name: Keeper of Souls
keeperOfSouls.text: When you kill a foe, its fading life heals you for 10% of your max HP.

knowledge.name: Knowledge Domain
knowledge.summary: A god of learning: you know a little about everything, and you can read a foe's mind.

blessingsOfKnowledge.name: Blessings of Knowledge
blessingsOfKnowledge.text: Proficiency in Arcana and History, and +1 skill trick per fight (Knowledge of the Ages).

readThoughts.name: Channel Divinity: Read Thoughts
readThoughts.text: Action, spend Channel Divinity: one foe makes a Wisdom save or you take hold of its mind. It is charmed for 1 round.

visionsOfThePast.name: Visions of the Past
visionsOfThePast.text: You have seen how this fight goes: +1 reroll on each of your turns and +2 initiative.

light.name: Light Domain
light.summary: Sun and flame: you blind attackers with a flare and burn the darkness away.

wardingFlare.name: Warding Flare
wardingFlare.text: Bonus Action, Wisdom modifier times per long rest: a flare of light makes attacks against one ally fall short (they are blurred until your next turn).

radianceOfTheDawn.name: Channel Divinity: Radiance of the Dawn
radianceOfTheDawn.text: Action, spend Channel Divinity: light floods out. Every foe takes 1d10 + your level in radiant damage (Constitution save halves).

coronaOfLight.name: Corona of Light
coronaOfLight.text: You shine like the sun: +1 spell save DC and +2 to your spell damage rolls.

nature.name: Nature Domain
nature.summary: A priest of the wild green gods who soothes beasts and shrugs off the weather.

acolyteOfNature.name: Acolyte of Nature
acolyteOfNature.text: Proficiency in Nature and Survival, and training with heavy armour.

charmAnimalsAndPlants.name: Channel Divinity: Charm Animals and Plants
charmAnimalsAndPlants.text: Action, spend Channel Divinity: every foe makes a Wisdom save or is charmed for 1 round.

dampenElements.name: Dampen Elements
dampenElements.text: Resistance to cold, fire and lightning.

masterOfNature.name: Master of Nature
masterOfNature.text: Green dice answer you: verdant dice count as your colour, and Sets you play get +2 Mult.

order.name: Order Domain
order.summary: Law made holy: your commands carry weight, and the guilty find their hands empty.

voiceOfAuthority.name: Voice of Authority
voiceOfAuthority.text: Training with heavy armour and proficiency in Intimidation.

ordersDemand.name: Channel Divinity: Order's Demand
ordersDemand.text: Action, spend Channel Divinity: every foe makes a Wisdom save or drops its guard (weakened for 2 rounds).

embodimentOfTheLaw.name: Embodiment of the Law
embodimentOfTheLaw.text: Your commands are hard to refuse: +1 spell save DC.

peace.name: Peace Domain
peace.summary: A god of harmony binds your party together, so each one protects the others.

emboldeningBond.name: Emboldening Bond
emboldeningBond.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: bind the party together. Every ally is blessed for 10 rounds (+1d4 to attacks and saves).

balmOfPeace.name: Channel Divinity: Balm of Peace
balmOfPeace.text: Action, spend Channel Divinity: walk among your friends, healing each ally 1d6 + Wisdom.

protectiveBond.name: Protective Bond
protectiveBond.text: Bonded friends cover for each other: +1 AC and +1 to all saving throws.

expansiveBond.name: Expansive Bond
expansiveBond.text: The bond grows stronger: healing you give is 15% stronger, and +1 to all saving throws.

tempest.name: Tempest Domain
tempest.summary: Thunder and storm: lightning answers when you are struck, and your wrath splits the air.

wrathOfTheStorm.name: Wrath of the Storm
wrathOfTheStorm.text: Training with heavy armour and martial weapons. A melee attacker that hits you takes lightning damage equal to your level.

destructiveWrath.name: Channel Divinity: Destructive Wrath
destructiveWrath.text: Action, spend Channel Divinity: a thunderclap hits one rank of foes for 2d8 thunder (Constitution save halves).

stormborn.name: Stormborn
stormborn.text: You ride the storm: resistance to lightning and thunder, and +3 initiative.

trickery.name: Trickery Domain
trickery.summary: A god of mischief lends you illusions of yourself and a cloak of shadow.

invokeDuplicity.name: Channel Divinity: Invoke Duplicity
invokeDuplicity.text: Bonus Action, spend Channel Divinity: illusory copies of you appear (Mirror Image for 10 rounds).

cloakOfShadows.name: Channel Divinity: Cloak of Shadows
cloakOfShadows.text: Bonus Action, spend Channel Divinity: you vanish. You are invisible until the end of your next turn.

improvedDuplicity.name: Improved Duplicity
improvedDuplicity.text: Your duplicates fight too: Pairs and Two Pairs you play get +3 Mult.

twilight.name: Twilight Domain
twilight.summary: A guardian of the dusk who comforts friends in the dark and sees what hides there.

vigilantBlessing.name: Vigilant Blessing and Eyes of Night
vigilantBlessing.text: Training with heavy armour and martial weapons, and +3 initiative.

twilightSanctuary.name: Channel Divinity: Twilight Sanctuary
twilightSanctuary.text: Action, spend Channel Divinity: soft twilight surrounds the party. Every ally gains temporary HP equal to 3/4 of your level (×vitality).

stepsOfNight.name: Steps of Night
stepsOfNight.text: You move unseen through dim light: you start each fight hidden.

twilightShroud.name: Twilight Shroud
twilightShroud.text: The dusk wraps you and your friends: +1 AC and +1 to all saving throws.

war.name: War Domain
war.summary: A god of battle guides your weapon: extra strikes, sure blows and an avatar's courage.

warPriest.name: War Priest
warPriest.text: Training with heavy armour and martial weapons. Bonus Action, Wisdom modifier times per long rest: make one extra weapon attack.

guidedStrike.name: Channel Divinity: Guided Strike
guidedStrike.text: Bonus Action, spend Channel Divinity: your god guides your hand. +5 to your attack rolls until your next turn.

warGodsBlessing.name: Channel Divinity: War God's Blessing
warGodsBlessing.text: Bonus Action, spend Channel Divinity: an ally gains +5 to attack rolls until your next turn.

avatarOfBattle.name: Avatar of Battle
avatarOfBattle.text: You fight like your god: +10% to all your damage.

land.name: Circle of the Land
land.summary: Druids of a home landscape: its magic answers your call and its earth restores your spells.

landsAid.name: Land's Aid
landsAid.text: Spend Wild Shape: foes in a rank take 2d6 necrotic (CON half) and an ally heals 2d6 (3d6 at 10, 4d6 at 14).

naturalRecovery.name: Natural Recovery
naturalRecovery.text: Recover spell slots on a short rest (once per expedition).

naturesSanctuary.name: Nature's Sanctuary
naturesSanctuary.text: Allies in your rank gain resistance while you are Wild Shaped.

dreams.name: Circle of Dreams
dreams.summary: Touched by the Feywild: you carry the warmth of a summer court and walk hidden paths.

balmOfTheSummerCourt.name: Balm of the Summer Court
balmOfTheSummerCourt.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: fey warmth heals one ally 2d6 + Wisdom.

hearthOfMoonlightAndShadow.name: Hearth of Moonlight and Shadow
hearthOfMoonlightAndShadow.text: Your camps are always safe and your mind always calm: +1 to all saving throws.

hiddenPaths.name: Hidden Paths
hiddenPaths.text: Bonus Action, Wisdom modifier times per long rest: step along a fey path. You are blurred for 2 rounds.

walkerInDreams.name: Walker in Dreams
walkerInDreams.text: You glimpse what is coming: +1 reroll on each of your turns.

spores.name: Circle of Spores
spores.summary: Rot and renewal: a halo of spores poisons anything that comes near you.

haloOfSpores.name: Halo of Spores
haloOfSpores.text: A melee attacker that hits you takes necrotic damage equal to your level.

symbioticEntity.name: Symbiotic Entity
symbioticEntity.text: Bonus Action, spend a Wild Shape: spores fill your body. Temporary HP equal to your level (×vitality), and +1d4 radiant on your hits for 10 rounds.

fungalInfestation.name: Fungal Infestation
fungalInfestation.text: The fallen rise for you a moment: each kill gives you +1 reroll that turn.

spreadingSpores.name: Spreading Spores
spreadingSpores.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: hurl spores at one rank of foes for 2d4 necrotic (Constitution save halves).

fungalBody.name: Fungal Body
fungalBody.text: Your flesh is fungus: you can't be blinded, frightened or poisoned.

stars.name: Circle of Stars
stars.summary: You read the night sky and take on a starry form of archer, chalice or dragon.

starMap.name: Star Map
starMap.text: Proficiency in Arcana, and +1 skill trick per fight.

starryForm.name: Starry Form
starryForm.text: Bonus Action, spend a Wild Shape: the Archer constellation looses a radiant arrow at one foe for 2d8 + Wisdom.

cosmicOmen.name: Cosmic Omen
cosmicOmen.text: Each morning's omen guides you: +1 reroll on each of your turns.

twinklingConstellations.name: Twinkling Constellations
twinklingConstellations.text: Your constellations brighten: +2 to your spell damage rolls, and healing you give is 10% stronger.

fullOfStars.name: Full of Stars
fullOfStars.text: You are partly made of starlight: the first hit you take each fight deals nothing, and +1 AC.

moon.name: Circle of the Moon
moon.summary: A shapechanger who fights in beast form and later as living elements.

combatWildShape.name: Combat Wild Shape and Circle Forms
combatWildShape.text: You change shape for battle: +1 Wild Shape use and +1 AC.

primalStrike.name: Primal Strike
primalStrike.text: Your strikes carry primal force: weapon and beast hits add 1d6 force.

elementalWildShape.name: Elemental Wild Shape
elementalWildShape.text: Bonus Action, spend two Wild Shapes: become an elemental. Your skin turns to stone (resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing) for 10 rounds, with temporary HP equal to twice your level.

thousandForms.name: Thousand Forms
thousandForms.text: You reshape your wounds away: regain 3% of your max HP at the start of each of your turns.

shepherd.name: Circle of the Shepherd
shepherd.summary: A guardian of beasts who calls spirit totems and strengthens every creature that answers.

spiritTotem.name: Spirit Totem (Bear)
spiritTotem.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: a bear spirit gives every ally temporary HP equal to 3/4 of your level (×vitality). You also speak with beasts (Animal Handling).

mightySummoner.name: Mighty Summoner
mightySummoner.text: Your magic is sturdier: +2 to your spell damage rolls and +5% max HP.

guardianSpirit.name: Guardian Spirit
guardianSpirit.text: Your totem mends those it guards: regain 2% of your max HP at the start of each of your turns.

faithfulSummons.name: Faithful Summons
faithfulSummons.text: Beasts come to save you: the first time you would drop to 0 HP in a fight, you stay at 1 HP instead.

wildfire.name: Circle of Wildfire
wildfire.summary: Fire that clears the way for new growth: a wildfire spirit burns foes and cauterises friends.

summonWildfireSpirit.name: Summon Wildfire Spirit
summonWildfireSpirit.text: Action, spend a Wild Shape: your wildfire spirit bursts into one rank of foes for 2d6 fire (Dexterity save halves).

enhancedBond.name: Enhanced Bond
enhancedBond.text: The spirit feeds your magic: +2 to your spell damage rolls, and healing you give is 10% stronger.

cauterizingFlames.name: Cauterizing Flames
cauterizingFlames.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: spectral flame seals one ally's wounds for 2d10 + Wisdom.

blazingRevival.name: Blazing Revival
blazingRevival.text: Your spirit sacrifices itself for you: the first time you would drop to 0 HP in a fight, you stay at 1 HP instead.

champion.name: Champion
champion.summary: Raw athletic excellence: more crits, more styles and a body that refuses to quit.

remarkableAthlete.name: Remarkable Athlete
remarkableAthlete.text: Advantage on initiative and Athletics checks.

heroicWarrior.name: Heroic Warrior
heroicWarrior.text: Start each of your turns with one extra reroll.

survivor.name: Survivor
survivor.text: At the start of your turn while bloodied, regain 5 + CON HP.

arcaneArcher.name: Arcane Archer
arcaneArcher.summary: Elven archery magic: every few arrows carries a spell.

arcaneShot.name: Arcane Shot
arcaneShot.text: Attack action, twice per short rest: a grasping arrow. Your first hit adds 2d6 force and the target makes a Strength save or is slowed for 2 rounds. You also learn Arcana (Arcane Archer Lore).

magicArrow.name: Magic Arrow and Curving Shot
magicArrow.text: Your arrows bend toward their mark: +1 Arcane Shot use and +1 to hit and damage with weapons.

everReadyShot.name: Ever-Ready Shot
everReadyShot.text: You always have magic on the string: +2 Arcane Shot uses.

battleMaster.name: Battle Master
battleMaster.summary: A student of war who spends superiority dice on trips, rallies and precise strikes.

tripAttack.name: Combat Superiority: Trip Attack
tripAttack.text: Attack action, spend a superiority die: your first hit adds 1d8 and the target makes a Strength save or falls prone.

rally.name: Combat Superiority: Rally
rally.text: Bonus Action, spend a superiority die: one ally gains temporary HP equal to half your level (×vitality). You also know History (Student of War).

knowYourEnemy.name: Know Your Enemy
knowYourEnemy.text: You size up foes quickly: +1 superiority die and +2 initiative.

improvedCombatSuperiority.name: Improved Combat Superiority
improvedCombatSuperiority.text: Your dice grow larger: +1 superiority die and +5% to all your damage.

relentless.name: Relentless
relentless.text: You never run dry: +1 superiority die and +1 reroll on each of your turns.

ultimateSuperiority.name: Ultimate Combat Superiority
ultimateSuperiority.text: Every maneuver lands harder: +5% to all your damage.

cavalier.name: Cavalier
cavalier.summary: A mounted knight who marks a foe, guards companions and holds the line.

unwaveringMark.name: Unwavering Mark
unwaveringMark.text: Attack action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: your first hit adds 1d8 and marks the foe for 2 rounds (your hits on it add 1d6). You also know Animal Handling (Born to the Saddle).

wardingManeuver.name: Warding Maneuver
wardingManeuver.text: Bonus Action, Constitution modifier times per long rest: interpose your shield. One ally gains +4 AC until your next turn.

holdTheLine.name: Hold the Line
holdTheLine.text: Foes who close on you pay for it: melee attackers that hit you take piercing damage equal to your level.

ferociousCharger.name: Ferocious Charger
ferociousCharger.text: Your charges bowl foes over: weapon hits add 1d6 bludgeoning.

vigilantDefender.name: Vigilant Defender
vigilantDefender.text: You strike at every opening: melee attackers that hit you take another hit of piercing damage equal to your level.

echoKnight.name: Echo Knight
echoKnight.summary: You summon an echo of yourself from another timeline and fight from two places at once.

unleashIncarnation.name: Manifest Echo and Unleash Incarnation
unleashIncarnation.text: Bonus Action, Constitution modifier times per long rest: your echo makes one extra weapon attack.

echoAvatar.name: Echo Avatar
echoAvatar.text: Your echo scouts ahead: +1 skill trick per fight.

shadowMartyr.name: Shadow Martyr
shadowMartyr.text: Bonus Action, once per short rest: your echo throws itself in front of an ally. Attacks against them have disadvantage until your next turn.

reclaimPotential.name: Reclaim Potential
reclaimPotential.text: Fading echoes return their strength to you: regain 2% of your max HP at the start of each of your turns.

legionOfOne.name: Legion of One
legionOfOne.text: Echoes everywhere: +2 Unleash Incarnation uses and +1 reroll on each of your turns.

eldritchKnight.name: Eldritch Knight
eldritchKnight.summary: A warrior trained in wizard magic who blends spell and blade.

ekSpellcasting.name: Spellcasting
ekSpellcasting.text: Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: cast a battle spell at one foe for 2d8 + Intelligence force.

weaponBond.name: Weapon Bond
weaponBond.text: Your bonded weapon never leaves your hand and turns blows aside: +1 AC.

warMagic.name: War Magic
warMagic.text: Bonus Action, spend an Eldritch Spell use: follow a spell with one extra weapon attack.

arcaneCharge.name: Arcane Charge
arcaneCharge.text: You teleport into the fray: +3 initiative and +1 Eldritch Spell use.

improvedWarMagic.name: Improved War Magic
improvedWarMagic.text: Spell and steel are one motion: +8% to all your damage.

psiWarrior.name: Psi Warrior
psiWarrior.summary: Psionic energy powers your strikes, shields your friends and throws your foes.

psionicStrike.name: Psionic Strike
psionicStrike.text: Attack action, spend a psionic die: your first hit adds 1d8 + Intelligence force.

protectiveField.name: Protective Field
protectiveField.text: Bonus Action, spend a psionic die: a field of force gives one ally +3 AC until your next turn.

telekineticAdept.name: Telekinetic Adept
telekineticAdept.text: Bonus Action, spend a psionic die: shove a foe with your mind. It makes a Strength save or falls prone.

guardedMind.name: Guarded Mind
guardedMind.text: Resistance to psychic damage, and you can't be charmed or frightened.

bulwarkOfForce.name: Bulwark of Force
bulwarkOfForce.text: Bonus Action, spend two psionic dice: shield the whole party. Every ally gains +2 AC for 3 rounds.

telekineticMaster.name: Telekinetic Master
telekineticMaster.text: Your mind never tires: +2 psionic dice and +5% to all your damage.

purpleDragonKnight.name: Purple Dragon Knight
purpleDragonKnight.summary: A banneret whose courage spreads through the ranks: when you rally, everyone rallies.

rallyingCry.name: Rallying Cry
rallyingCry.text: Bonus Action, spend a Second Wind: rally the party. Every ally heals your level.

inspiringSurge.name: Inspiring Surge
inspiringSurge.text: Bonus Action, once per long rest: an ally catches your momentum and is hasted for 2 rounds.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.text: Your resolve covers others: +1 Indomitable use and +1 to all saving throws.

runeKnight.name: Rune Knight
runeKnight.summary: Giant runes carved into your gear let you grow huge and turn aside blows.

giantsMight.name: Giant's Might
giantsMight.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: grow to giant size. +1d4 radiant on your hits for 10 rounds and temporary HP equal to half your level.

runeCarver.name: Rune Carver
runeCarver.text: Your runes harden you: resistance to poison and proficiency in Athletics.

runicShield.name: Runic Shield
runicShield.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: a rune twists fate around an ally. Attacks against them fall short (blurred) until your next turn.

greatStature.name: Great Stature
greatStature.text: The runes make you permanently bigger: weapon hits add 1d4 thunder, and +5% max HP.

masterOfRunes.name: Master of Runes
masterOfRunes.text: Each rune works twice: +1 use of Giant's Might and of Runic Shield.

runicJuggernaut.name: Runic Juggernaut
runicJuggernaut.text: You grow huge: +8% to all your damage and +5% max HP.

samurai.name: Samurai
samurai.summary: An indomitable fighting spirit: focus, grace and a refusal to fall.

fightingSpirit.name: Fighting Spirit
fightingSpirit.text: Bonus Action, three times per long rest: focus your spirit. Your next attack has advantage and you gain temporary HP equal to half your level (×vitality). You also know Insight.

elegantCourtier.name: Elegant Courtier
elegantCourtier.text: Composure in any court: proficiency in Persuasion and +1 to all saving throws.

tirelessSpirit.name: Tireless Spirit
tirelessSpirit.text: Your spirit renews itself: +1 Fighting Spirit use.

rapidStrike.name: Rapid Strike
rapidStrike.text: You trade precision for extra cuts: +10% to all your damage.

strengthBeforeDeath.name: Strength before Death
strengthBeforeDeath.text: The first time you would drop to 0 HP in a fight, you stay at 1 HP instead.

openHand.name: Warrior of the Open Hand
openHand.summary: Masters of unarmed combat who knock foes around and heal their own wounds.

openHandTechnique.name: Open Hand Technique
openHandTechnique.text: Flurry hits can topple (DEX save or prone) or push the target to the back rank.

wholenessOfBody.name: Wholeness of Body
wholenessOfBody.text: Bonus Action: heal Martial Arts die + WIS.

fleetStep.name: Fleet Step
fleetStep.text: Patient Defense also lets you switch ranks.

quiveringPalm.name: Quivering Palm
quiveringPalm.text: 4 Focus: on hit, CON save or take 10d12 force (half on success).

mercy.name: Way of Mercy
mercy.summary: Masked healers who can mend a wound or open one with the same touch.

handOfHealing.name: Hand of Healing
handOfHealing.text: Bonus Action, spend 1 Focus: heal one ally 1d6 + Wisdom. You also know Insight and Medicine (Implements of Mercy).

handOfHarm.name: Hand of Harm
handOfHarm.text: Attack action, spend 1 Focus: your first hit adds 1d6 + Wisdom necrotic.

flurryOfHealingAndHarm.name: Flurry of Healing and Harm
flurryOfHealingAndHarm.text: Your weapon hits add 1d4 necrotic, and healing you give is another 10% stronger.

handOfUltimateMercy.name: Hand of Ultimate Mercy
handOfUltimateMercy.text: Action, once per long rest: pour your life into an ally, healing them 6d10 + Wisdom.

shadow.name: Way of Shadow
shadow.summary: Ninja-like monks who step between shadows and strike from darkness.

shadowArts.name: Shadow Arts
shadowArts.text: Bonus Action, spend 1 Focus: wrap yourself in darkness. Your next attack has advantage. You also know Stealth.

shadowStep.name: Shadow Step
shadowStep.text: You step out of the shadows when a fight begins: you start each fight hidden.

cloakOfShadowsMonk.name: Cloak of Shadows
cloakOfShadowsMonk.text: Bonus Action, spend 2 Focus: become invisible until the end of your next turn.

opportunist.name: Opportunist
opportunist.text: You strike at every opening your friends make: +8% to all your damage.

ascendantDragon.name: Way of the Ascendant Dragon
ascendantDragon.summary: You study the dragons: you breathe their element and wear their wings.

breathOfTheDragon.name: Breath of the Dragon
breathOfTheDragon.text: Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: exhale fire over one rank of foes for 2d6 (Dexterity save halves). You also know Intimidation (Draconic Disciple).

wingsUnfurled.name: Wings Unfurled
wingsUnfurled.text: Spectral wings carry you into the fight: +2 initiative and resistance to fire.

aspectOfTheWyrm.name: Aspect of the Wyrm
aspectOfTheWyrm.text: Bonus Action, spend 3 Focus: draconic presence. Every foe makes a Wisdom save or is frightened for 2 rounds.

ascendantAspect.name: Ascendant Aspect
ascendantAspect.text: Your breath and blows burn: +2 Breath of the Dragon uses, and your weapon hits add 1d6 fire.

astralSelf.name: Way of the Astral Self
astralSelf.summary: You summon spectral arms and a mask from your own soul.

armsOfTheAstralSelf.name: Arms of the Astral Self
