armsOfTheAstralSelf.text: Bonus Action, spend 1 Focus: astral arms join your strikes. +1d4 radiant on your hits for 10 rounds.

visageOfTheAstralSelf.name: Visage of the Astral Self
visageOfTheAstralSelf.text: An astral mask sharpens your senses: proficiency in Insight and Intimidation.

bodyOfTheAstralSelf.name: Body of the Astral Self
bodyOfTheAstralSelf.text: Your astral body deflects energy and lands harder blows: resistance to fire, cold and lightning, and weapon hits add 1d6 force.

awakenedAstralSelf.name: Awakened Astral Self
awakenedAstralSelf.text: Your full astral self fights beside you: +2 AC and three attacks per Attack action.

cobaltSoul.name: Way of the Cobalt Soul
cobaltSoul.summary: Monk-scholars who read a foe's weaknesses in the way it fights.

extractAspects.name: Extract Aspects
extractAspects.text: Bonus Action, spend 1 Focus: read one foe's weak points. Attacks against it have advantage for 2 rounds.

mysticalErudition.name: Extort Truth and Mystical Erudition
mysticalErudition.text: Proficiency in Arcana, Investigation and Religion, and +1 skill trick per fight.

mindOfMercury.name: Mind of Mercury
mindOfMercury.text: You think faster than the fight: +1 reroll on each of your turns.

debilitatingBarrage.name: Debilitating Barrage
debilitatingBarrage.text: Attack action, spend 3 Focus: your first hit adds 6d8 and leaves the foe vulnerable (it takes +25% damage) for 2 rounds.

drunkenMaster.name: Way of the Drunken Master
drunkenMaster.summary: A staggering, swaying style that looks like luck and is nothing of the kind.

drunkenTechnique.name: Drunken Technique
drunkenTechnique.text: You weave out of reach: +1 AC and proficiency in Performance.

tipsySway.name: Tipsy Sway
tipsySway.text: You redirect clumsy blows: melee attackers that hit you take bludgeoning damage equal to your level.

drunkardsLuck.name: Drunkard's Luck
drunkardsLuck.text: Fortune favours the stumbling: +1 reroll on each of your turns.

intoxicatedFrenzy.name: Intoxicated Frenzy
intoxicatedFrenzy.text: Your flurry spreads across the whole fight: +10% to all your damage.

fourElements.name: Way of the Four Elements
fourElements.summary: You bend fire, water, earth and air through your focus.

fangsOfTheFireSnake.name: Elemental Discipline: Fist of Four Thunders
fangsOfTheFireSnake.text: Action, spend 2 Focus: a thunderclap hits one rank of foes for 2d6 thunder (Constitution save halves).

waterWhip.name: Elemental Discipline: Water Whip
waterWhip.text: Bonus Action, spend 2 Focus: a whip of water lashes one foe for 3d6 bludgeoning (Dexterity save) and knocks it prone.

riverOfHungryFlame.name: Elemental Discipline: Flames of the Phoenix
riverOfHungryFlame.text: Action, spend 3 Focus: a burst of fire hits one rank of foes for 6d6 fire (Dexterity save halves).

breathOfWinter.name: Elemental Discipline: Breath of Winter
breathOfWinter.text: Action, spend 4 Focus: freezing wind hits every foe for 9d6 cold (Constitution save halves).

kensei.name: Way of the Kensei
kensei.summary: Weapon masters who make a chosen blade part of their own body.

pathOfTheKensei.name: Path of the Kensei
pathOfTheKensei.text: Proficiency with martial weapons. Agile Parry gives +1 AC, and your weapon hits add 1d4 piercing (Kensei's Shot).

oneWithTheBlade.name: One with the Blade
oneWithTheBlade.text: Your kensei weapons are magical to you: +1 to hit and damage with weapons.

sharpenTheBlade.name: Sharpen the Blade
sharpenTheBlade.text: Bonus Action, spend 3 Focus: hone your weapon. +3 to your attack rolls for 10 rounds.

unerringAccuracy.name: Unerring Accuracy
unerringAccuracy.text: Your strikes find their mark: crits on 19–20 and +1 reroll on each of your turns.

longDeath.name: Way of the Long Death
longDeath.summary: Monks who study dying, and draw strength from every death they cause.

touchOfDeathMonk.name: Touch of Death
touchOfDeathMonk.text: When you kill a foe you drink in its last breath: heal 8% of your max HP.

hourOfReaping.name: Hour of Reaping
hourOfReaping.text: Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: every foe makes a Wisdom save or is frightened for 2 rounds.

masteryOfDeath.name: Mastery of Death
masteryOfDeath.text: The first time you would drop to 0 HP in a fight, you stay at 1 HP instead.

touchOfTheLongDeath.name: Touch of the Long Death
touchOfTheLongDeath.text: Action, spend 4 Focus: touch one foe for 6d10 necrotic (Constitution save halves).

sunSoul.name: Way of the Sun Soul
sunSoul.summary: You channel your focus into bolts and bursts of searing light.

radiantSunBolt.name: Radiant Sun Bolt
radiantSunBolt.text: Bonus Action, spend 1 Focus: hurl a bolt of light at one foe for 1d8 + Dexterity radiant.

searingArcStrike.name: Searing Arc Strike
searingArcStrike.text: Bonus Action, spend 2 Focus: a fan of flame hits one rank of foes for 4d6 fire (Dexterity save halves).

searingSunburst.name: Searing Sunburst
searingSunburst.text: Action, spend 2 Focus: a globe of light bursts over every foe for 4d6 radiant (Constitution save halves).

sunShield.name: Sun Shield
sunShield.text: You shine with burning light: melee attackers that hit you take radiant damage equal to twice your level.

devotion.name: Oath of Devotion
devotion.summary: The classic knight in shining armour: honesty, courage and a holy weapon.

sacredWeapon.name: Sacred Weapon
sacredWeapon.text: Channel Divinity, Bonus Action: add CHA to attack rolls for 10 rounds; weapon sheds holy light.

smiteOfProtection.name: Smite of Protection
smiteOfProtection.text: When you Smite, allies gain +2 AC until your next turn.

holyNimbus.name: Holy Nimbus
holyNimbus.text: Once per long rest: radiant aura deals CHA + PB to foes each turn and grants advantage on saves.

conquest.name: Oath of Conquest
conquest.summary: Rule through fear: crush the enemy's will before you crush the enemy.

conqueringPresence.name: Channel Divinity: Conquering Presence
conqueringPresence.text: Action, spend Channel Divinity: every foe makes a Wisdom save or is frightened for 2 rounds.

auraOfConquest.name: Aura of Conquest
auraOfConquest.text: Foes near you feel your contempt: your weapon hits add 1d4 psychic.

scornfulRebuke.name: Scornful Rebuke
scornfulRebuke.text: Those who strike you suffer for it: melee attackers that hit you take psychic damage equal to twice your level.

invincibleConqueror.name: Invincible Conqueror
invincibleConqueror.text: Bonus Action, once per long rest: become a conqueror. You are hasted for 10 rounds (an extra play each turn, +2 AC).

glory.name: Oath of Glory
glory.summary: Heroes of legend in the making, who inspire everyone around them.

inspiringSmite.name: Channel Divinity: Inspiring Smite
inspiringSmite.text: Bonus Action, spend Channel Divinity: every ally gains temporary HP equal to half your level (×vitality). You also know Athletics (Peerless Athlete).

auraOfAlacrity.name: Aura of Alacrity
auraOfAlacrity.text: You move like a champion: +3 initiative.

gloriousDefense.name: Glorious Defense
gloriousDefense.text: Bonus Action, Charisma modifier times per long rest: one ally gains +4 AC until your next turn.

livingLegend.name: Living Legend
livingLegend.text: Your legend bends luck: +1 reroll on each of your turns and +8% to all your damage.

redemption.name: Oath of Redemption
redemption.summary: Peace first, but violence turned back on those who choose it.

rebukeTheViolent.name: Channel Divinity: Rebuke the Violent
rebukeTheViolent.text: Bonus Action, spend Channel Divinity: one foe takes 2d8 + Charisma radiant (Wisdom save halves). You also know Persuasion (Emissary of Peace).

auraOfTheGuardian.name: Aura of the Guardian
auraOfTheGuardian.text: You take blows meant for others: +10% max HP.

protectiveSpirit.name: Protective Spirit
protectiveSpirit.text: A holy presence mends you: regain 2% of your max HP at the start of each of your turns.

emissaryOfRedemption.name: Emissary of Redemption
emissaryOfRedemption.text: Harming you is a mistake: melee attackers that hit you take radiant damage equal to three times your level, and +1 to all saving throws.

ancients.name: Oath of the Ancients
ancients.summary: Green knights sworn to protect light and life against the dark.

naturesWrath.name: Channel Divinity: Nature's Wrath
naturesWrath.text: Action, spend Channel Divinity: spectral vines seize one foe. It makes a Strength save or is restrained for 2 rounds.

auraOfWarding.name: Aura of Warding
auraOfWarding.text: Ancient magic turns spells aside: resistance to fire, cold, lightning and necrotic.

undyingSentinel.name: Undying Sentinel
undyingSentinel.text: The first time you would drop to 0 HP in a fight, you stay at 1 HP instead.

elderChampion.name: Elder Champion
elderChampion.text: You become an ancient force of nature: regain 3% of your max HP at the start of each turn, and +1 spell save DC.

crown.name: Oath of the Crown
crown.summary: Sworn to the law and the realm: the shield wall that never breaks.

championChallenge.name: Channel Divinity: Champion Challenge
championChallenge.text: Action, spend Channel Divinity: challenge every foe. Each makes a Wisdom save or is weakened (disadvantage on its next attack) for 2 rounds.

turnTheTide.name: Channel Divinity: Turn the Tide
turnTheTide.text: Bonus Action, spend Channel Divinity: every ally heals 1d6 + Charisma.

divineAllegiance.name: Divine Allegiance
divineAllegiance.text: You take wounds meant for others: +10% max HP.

unyieldingSpirit.name: Unyielding Spirit
unyieldingSpirit.text: You can't be paralyzed or stunned, and +1 to all saving throws.

exaltedChampion.name: Exalted Champion
exaltedChampion.text: You stand as the realm's champion: +1 AC, +1 to all saving throws and +5% max HP.

watchers.name: Oath of the Watchers
watchers.summary: Guardians against things from beyond the world.

watchersWill.name: Channel Divinity: Watcher's Will
watchersWill.text: Bonus Action, spend Channel Divinity: steel the party's minds. Every ally is blessed for 3 rounds.

abjureTheExtraplanar.name: Channel Divinity: Abjure the Extraplanar
abjureTheExtraplanar.text: Action, spend Channel Divinity: every foe makes a Wisdom save or is frightened for 2 rounds.

vigilantRebuke.name: Vigilant Rebuke
vigilantRebuke.text: Melee attackers that hit you take force damage equal to twice your level.

mortalBulwark.name: Mortal Bulwark
mortalBulwark.text: Bonus Action, once per long rest: see every foe as it truly is. +5 to your attack rolls for 10 rounds.

vengeance.name: Oath of Vengeance
vengeance.summary: Punish the wicked at any cost: mark a foe and never let it go.

vowOfEnmity.name: Channel Divinity: Vow of Enmity
vowOfEnmity.text: Bonus Action, spend Channel Divinity: swear a vow against one foe. It is marked for 10 rounds (your hits on it add 1d6).

relentlessAvenger.name: Relentless Avenger
relentlessAvenger.text: No one escapes you: +2 initiative and your weapon hits add 1d4 slashing.

soulOfVengeance.name: Soul of Vengeance
soulOfVengeance.text: You punish every blow: melee attackers that hit you take slashing damage equal to twice your level.

avengingAngel.name: Avenging Angel
avengingAngel.text: Action, once per long rest: unfurl wings of wrath. Every foe makes a Wisdom save or is frightened for 3 rounds.

oathbreaker.name: Oathbreaker
oathbreaker.summary: A fallen paladin who serves darker powers now, and strikes fear instead of hope.

dreadfulAspect.name: Channel Divinity: Dreadful Aspect
dreadfulAspect.text: Action, spend Channel Divinity: every foe makes a Wisdom save or is frightened for 2 rounds. You also command lesser undead (Control Undead).

auraOfHate.name: Aura of Hate
auraOfHate.text: Hatred lends you strength: your weapon hits add 1d6 necrotic.

supernaturalResistance.name: Supernatural Resistance
supernaturalResistance.text: Resistance to necrotic and poison damage, and +1 AC.

dreadLord.name: Dread Lord
dreadLord.text: Bonus Action, once per long rest: an aura of gloom hides you. You are blurred for 10 rounds.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.summary: A specialist in hunting dangerous prey, from giants to hordes.

huntersPrey.name: Hunter's Prey: Colossus Slayer
huntersPrey.text: Once per turn, +1d8 damage to a target that is already wounded.

defensiveTactics.name: Defensive Tactics: Multiattack Defense
defensiveTactics.text: After a creature hits you, its further attacks this turn have disadvantage.

volley.name: Superior Hunter's Prey: Volley
volley.text: Action: make a ranged attack against every enemy in one rank.

superiorHuntersDefense.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
superiorHuntersDefense.text: Reaction: resistance to one attack's damage.

beastMaster.name: Beast Master
beastMaster.summary: A primal beast fights at your side and shares your magic.

primalCompanion.name: Primal Companion
primalCompanion.text: Your beast fights with you: weapon hits add 1d4 piercing. Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per short rest: command it to strike one foe for 1d8 + Wisdom.

exceptionalTraining.name: Exceptional Training
exceptionalTraining.text: Your beast's attacks count as magical: weapon hits add 1d4 force.

bestialFury.name: Bestial Fury
bestialFury.text: Your beast attacks twice: +2 Beast's Strike uses and +5% to all your damage.

shareSpells.name: Share Spells
shareSpells.text: Your spells reach your beast too: healing you give is 10% stronger and +1 to all saving throws.

drakewarden.name: Drakewarden
drakewarden.summary: A small drake grows beside you into a dragon you can ride.

drakeCompanion.name: Drake Companion
drakeCompanion.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: your drake bites one foe for 1d6 + Wisdom fire. You also know Intimidation (Draconic Gift).

bondOfFangAndScale.name: Bond of Fang and Scale
bondOfFangAndScale.text: Resistance to fire, and your weapon hits add 1d4 fire.

drakesBreath.name: Drake's Breath
drakesBreath.text: Action, once per short rest: you or your drake breathe over one rank of foes for 6d6 fire (Dexterity save halves).

perfectedBond.name: Perfected Bond
perfectedBond.text: Your drake is full-grown: resistance to cold and +1 AC.

feyWanderer.name: Fey Wanderer
feyWanderer.summary: Fey magic follows you: charming words and dreadful strikes.

dreadfulStrikes.name: Dreadful Strikes and Otherworldly Glamour
dreadfulStrikes.text: Your weapon hits add 1d4 psychic, and you gain proficiency in Persuasion.

beguilingTwist.name: Beguiling Twist
beguilingTwist.text: Bonus Action, Wisdom modifier times per long rest: fey glamour twists one foe's mind. It makes a Wisdom save or is charmed for 1 round.

feyReinforcements.name: Fey Reinforcements
feyReinforcements.text: Bonus Action, once per long rest: fey spirits join the party. Every ally strikes harder for 3 rounds (+1d4 radiant on hits).

mistyWanderer.name: Misty Wanderer
mistyWanderer.text: Bonus Action, spend a Beguiling Twist use: step through the mist. You are blurred for 2 rounds.

gloomStalker.name: Gloom Stalker
gloomStalker.summary: A hunter in the dark who strikes first and vanishes from sight.

dreadAmbusher.name: Dread Ambusher and Umbral Sight
dreadAmbusher.text: You strike from the dark: +3 initiative and you start each fight hidden.

ironMind.name: Iron Mind
ironMind.text: Your mind is hard to touch: +1 to all saving throws.

stalkersFlurry.name: Stalker's Flurry
stalkersFlurry.text: A miss only means another try: +1 reroll on each of your turns and +5% to all your damage.

shadowyDodge.name: Shadowy Dodge
shadowyDodge.text: You slip the first blow: the first hit you take each fight deals nothing.

horizonWalker.name: Horizon Walker
horizonWalker.summary: A guardian of the planes who steps through space and strikes with planar force.

planarWarrior.name: Planar Warrior and Detect Portal
planarWarrior.text: Planar energy flows through your weapon: weapon hits add 1d4 force.

etherealStep.name: Ethereal Step
etherealStep.text: Bonus Action, once per short rest: step halfway out of the world. You are blurred for 2 rounds.

distantStrike.name: Distant Strike
distantStrike.text: You teleport between strikes: weapon hits add another 1d4 force, and +2 initiative.

spectralDefense.name: Spectral Defense
spectralDefense.text: You partly phase out when struck: +1 AC and +1 to all saving throws.

monsterSlayer.name: Monster Slayer
monsterSlayer.summary: A hunter of the supernatural who studies a monster before killing it.

slayersPrey.name: Slayer's Prey and Hunter's Sense
slayersPrey.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: study one foe. It is marked for 10 rounds (your hits on it add 1d6).

supernaturalDefense.name: Supernatural Defense
supernaturalDefense.text: You know a monster's tricks: +1 to all saving throws.

magicUsersNemesis.name: Magic-User's Nemesis
magicUsersNemesis.text: Action, once per short rest: disrupt one foe. It makes a Wisdom save or is incapacitated for 1 round.

slayersCounter.name: Slayer's Counter
slayersCounter.text: You strike back at once: melee attackers that hit you take piercing damage equal to twice your level.

swarmkeeper.name: Swarmkeeper
swarmkeeper.summary: A swarm of nature spirits, pixies or insects, fights around you.

gatheredSwarm.name: Gathered Swarm and Swarmkeeper Magic
gatheredSwarm.text: Your swarm stings whatever you strike: weapon hits add 1d6 piercing.

writhingTide.name: Writhing Tide
writhingTide.text: The swarm lifts you out of harm: +1 AC and +2 initiative.

mightySwarm.name: Mighty Swarm
mightySwarm.text: Your swarm grows: weapon hits add another 1d4 piercing.

swarmingDispersal.name: Swarming Dispersal
swarmingDispersal.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: dissolve into your swarm. You are blurred for 2 rounds.

thief.name: Thief
thief.summary: Burglars and treasure hunters: quick hands, quiet feet and any magic item will do.

fastHands.name: Fast Hands
fastHands.text: Use items as a Bonus Action.

supremeSneak.name: Supreme Sneak
supremeSneak.text: Hide costs nothing after an attack once per turn.

useMagicDevice.name: Use Magic Device
useMagicDevice.text: Use any scroll; attune to more trinkets.

thiefsReflexes.name: Thief's Reflexes
thiefsReflexes.text: Take two turns in the first round of combat.

arcaneTrickster.name: Arcane Trickster
arcaneTrickster.summary: A rogue who learned a little wizardry, mostly for mischief.

atSpellcasting.name: Spellcasting
atSpellcasting.text: Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: cast a trick spell at one foe for 2d6 + Intelligence force.

mageHandLegerdemain.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
mageHandLegerdemain.text: An invisible hand does your pickpocketing: proficiency in Sleight of Hand, with +2.

magicalAmbush.name: Magical Ambush
magicalAmbush.text: Your magic strikes from hiding: you start each fight hidden.

versatileTrickster.name: Versatile Trickster
versatileTrickster.text: Your mage hand distracts the foe: Pairs and Three of a Kind hands you play get +2 Mult.

spellThief.name: Spell Thief
spellThief.text: You steal magic from casters: +2 Trickster Spell uses and +1 to all saving throws.

assassin.name: Assassin
assassin.summary: Disguise, infiltration and one perfect killing blow.

assassinate.name: Assassinate
assassinate.text: You strike before they react: +3 initiative and you start each fight hidden. You also know Deception.

infiltrationExpertise.name: Infiltration Expertise
infiltrationExpertise.text: You can build false identities: +1 skill trick per fight.

impostor.name: Impostor
impostor.text: You mimic anyone: +3 to Deception and +1 reroll on each of your turns.

deathStrike.name: Death Strike
deathStrike.text: A critical hit leaves any foe that isn't a boss dead if it drops to 25% HP or less.

inquisitive.name: Inquisitive
inquisitive.summary: A detective who reads people and finds the weak spot in any defence.

insightfulFighting.name: Insightful Fighting
insightfulFighting.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: read one foe. Attacks against it have advantage for 2 rounds. You also know Insight and Investigation (Ear for Deceit, Eye for Detail).

unerringEye.name: Unerring Eye
unerringEye.text: You see through tricks: +1 to all saving throws.

mastermind.name: Mastermind
mastermind.summary: A schemer who directs the fight from the second rank and lies to everyone.

masterOfTactics.name: Master of Tactics and Intrigue
masterOfTactics.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per short rest: point out an opening. One ally's next attack has advantage. You also know Persuasion.

insightfulManipulator.name: Insightful Manipulator
insightfulManipulator.text: You size up anyone: +1 skill trick per fight.

misdirection.name: Misdirection
misdirection.text: You make someone else take the hit: the first hit you take each fight deals nothing.

soulOfDeceit.name: Soul of Deceit
soulOfDeceit.text: Your mind is closed: you can't be charmed, and +1 to all saving throws.

phantom.name: Phantom
phantom.summary: A rogue touched by death who carries soul trinkets and wails from the grave.

wailsFromTheGrave.name: Wails from the Grave
wailsFromTheGrave.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: a wail strikes one foe for 2d6 necrotic. You also know Religion (Whispers of the Dead).

tokensOfTheDeparted.name: Tokens of the Departed
tokensOfTheDeparted.text: You keep soul trinkets: +1 to all saving throws, and each kill gives you +1 reroll that turn.

ghostWalk.name: Ghost Walk
ghostWalk.text: Bonus Action, once per long rest: become a spectre. You are blurred for 10 rounds.

deathsFriend.name: Death's Friend
deathsFriend.text: Death feeds you: +2 Wails from the Grave uses, and each kill heals you 5% of your max HP.

scout.name: Scout
scout.summary: A skirmisher and survivalist who is always first to the fight and first out.

skirmisher.name: Skirmisher and Survivalist
skirmisher.text: Proficiency in Nature and Survival, and +2 initiative.

superiorMobility.name: Superior Mobility
superiorMobility.text: You are hard to pin down: +1 AC and +2 initiative.

ambushMaster.name: Ambush Master
ambushMaster.text: You open every fight: you start each fight hidden.

suddenStrike.name: Sudden Strike
suddenStrike.text: You strike twice with each Attack action.

soulknife.name: Soulknife
soulknife.summary: Blades of psychic energy appear in your hands, and your mind is a weapon.

psychicBladesRogue.name: Psychic Blades and Psionic Power
psychicBladesRogue.text: Your weapon hits add 1d4 psychic, and you know Insight.

soulBlades.name: Soul Blades
soulBlades.text: Attack action, spend a psionic die: guide your blade. Your first hit adds 2d8 psychic.

psychicVeil.name: Psychic Veil
psychicVeil.text: Bonus Action, spend a psionic die: vanish from minds. You are invisible for 2 rounds.

rendMind.name: Rend Mind
rendMind.text: Action, once per long rest: tear into a foe's mind. It makes a Wisdom save or is stunned for 1 round.

swashbuckler.name: Swashbuckler
swashbuckler.summary: A dashing duellist with fancy footwork and dangerous charm.

rakishAudacity.name: Fancy Footwork and Rakish Audacity
rakishAudacity.text: You swagger into every fight: +3 initiative and +1 AC.

panache.name: Panache
panache.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: charm one foe with pure swagger. It makes a Wisdom save or is charmed for 1 round.

masterDuelist.name: Master Duelist
masterDuelist.text: You turn misses into hits: +1 reroll on each of your turns, and crits on 19–20.

draconic.name: Draconic Sorcery
draconic.summary: Dragon blood in your veins: scaled skin, fire magic and, one day, wings.

draconicResilience.name: Draconic Resilience
draconicResilience.text: +1 HP per level; unarmored AC = 10 + DEX + CHA.

elementalAffinity.name: Elemental Affinity
elementalAffinity.text: Add CHA to fire spell damage; resist fire.

dragonWings.name: Dragon Wings
dragonWings.text: Fly over pits and chasms while exploring.

dragonCompanion.name: Dragon Companion
dragonCompanion.text: Resistance to your affinity element for the party.

aberrantMind.name: Aberrant Mind
aberrantMind.summary: Something from the Far Realm touched your mind, and now you touch others'.

psionicSpells.name: Psionic Spells and Telepathic Speech
psionicSpells.text: Action, spend 1 Sorcery Point: a mind sliver strikes one foe for 2d8 + Charisma psychic.

psychicDefenses.name: Psionic Sorcery and Psychic Defenses
psychicDefenses.text: Resistance to psychic damage, and you can't be charmed.

revelationInFlesh.name: Revelation in Flesh
revelationInFlesh.text: Your body shifts into something stranger: +1 AC and +2 initiative.

warpingImplosion.name: Warping Implosion
warpingImplosion.text: Action, once per long rest: space collapses around the foes. Every foe takes 8d10 force (Strength save halves).

clockworkSoul.name: Clockwork Soul
clockworkSoul.summary: The cosmic order of Mechanus flows through you, smoothing out chance.

restoreBalance.name: Clockwork Magic and Restore Balance
restoreBalance.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: cancel a foe's edge. It is weakened (disadvantage on its next attack) for 1 round.

bastionOfLaw.name: Bastion of Law
bastionOfLaw.text: Bonus Action, spend 2 Sorcery Points: ward an ally with temporary HP equal to 3/4 of your level (×vitality).

tranceOfOrder.name: Trance of Order
tranceOfOrder.text: Chance bends toward order: +1 reroll on each of your turns.

clockworkCavalcade.name: Clockwork Cavalcade
clockworkCavalcade.text: Action, once per long rest: spirits of order mend the party. Every ally heals 4d8 + Charisma.

divineSoul.name: Divine Soul
divineSoul.summary: A god's blessing runs in your blood: you heal like a priest and luck follows you.

favoredByTheGods.name: Divine Magic and Favored by the Gods
favoredByTheGods.text: +1 to all saving throws, and healing you give is 10% stronger.

empoweredHealing.name: Empowered Healing
empoweredHealing.text: Healing you give is another 15% stronger.

otherworldlyWings.name: Otherworldly Wings
otherworldlyWings.text: Spectral wings lift you: +1 AC and +2 initiative.

unearthlyRecovery.name: Unearthly Recovery
unearthlyRecovery.text: Bonus Action, once per long rest: divine power heals you 8d10 + your level.

shadowSorcery.name: Shadow Magic
shadowSorcery.summary: Born of the Shadowfell: darkness obeys you and death has trouble keeping you.

strengthOfTheGrave.name: Eyes of the Dark and Strength of the Grave
strengthOfTheGrave.text: The first time you would drop to 0 HP in a fight, you stay at 1 HP instead.

houndOfIllOmen.name: Hound of Ill Omen
houndOfIllOmen.text: Action, spend 3 Sorcery Points: a shadow hound savages one foe for 2d6 psychic and leaves it baned for 3 rounds.

shadowWalk.name: Shadow Walk
shadowWalk.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: step into the shadows. You are invisible until the end of your next turn.

umbralForm.name: Umbral Form
umbralForm.text: Bonus Action, spend 4 Sorcery Points: become living shadow. Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing for 10 rounds.

storm.name: Storm Sorcery
storm.summary: Your magic comes from elemental air: winds carry you and lightning answers.

tempestuousMagic.name: Wind Speaker and Tempestuous Magic
tempestuousMagic.text: Winds carry you into position: +2 initiative.

heartOfTheStorm.name: Heart of the Storm and Storm Guide
heartOfTheStorm.text: Resistance to lightning and thunder, and +2 to your spell damage rolls.

stormsFury.name: Storm's Fury
stormsFury.text: Lightning lashes anyone who strikes you: melee attackers that hit you take lightning damage equal to twice your level.

windSoul.name: Wind Soul
windSoul.text: You are one with the wind: +1 to all saving throws and +2 initiative.

wildMagicSorcery.name: Wild Magic
wildMagicSorcery.summary: Chaos magic that surges unpredictably, and luck you can bend.

tidesOfChaos.name: Wild Magic Surge and Tides of Chaos
tidesOfChaos.text: Wild magic seeps into every fight: each fight opens with a Wild die on the tray.

bendLuck.name: Bend Luck
bendLuck.text: Bonus Action, spend 2 Sorcery Points: bend an ally's luck. They are blessed for 3 rounds.

controlledChaos.name: Controlled Chaos
controlledChaos.text: You choose among the surges: +1 reroll on each of your turns.

spellBombardment.name: Spell Bombardment
spellBombardment.text: Your spells run wild: +4 to your spell damage rolls.

fiend.name: Fiend Patron
fiend.summary: A pact with a devil or demon: kills feed you and luck bends your way.

darkOnesBlessing.name: Dark One's Blessing
darkOnesBlessing.text: When you reduce an enemy to 0 HP, gain CHA + level temp HP.

darkOnesOwnLuck.name: Dark One's Own Luck
darkOnesOwnLuck.text: Add a d10 to a check or save — or turn one tray die to any face (CHA times per long rest).

hurlThroughHell.name: Hurl Through Hell
hurlThroughHell.text: Once per long rest: a target takes 8d10 psychic (CHA save avoids).

archfey.name: The Archfey
archfey.summary: A pact with a lord or lady of the fey: charm, fear and vanishing tricks.

feyPresence.name: Fey Presence
feyPresence.text: Action, once per short rest: fey majesty washes over every foe. Each makes a Wisdom save or is charmed for 1 round.

mistyEscape.name: Misty Escape
mistyEscape.text: Bonus Action, once per short rest: vanish in a puff of mist. You are invisible until the end of your next turn.

beguilingDefenses.name: Beguiling Defenses
beguilingDefenses.text: You can't be charmed, and melee attackers that hit you take psychic damage equal to your level.

darkDelirium.name: Dark Delirium
darkDelirium.text: Action, once per short rest: trap one foe in a fey illusion. It makes a Wisdom save or is charmed for 3 rounds.

celestial.name: The Celestial
celestial.summary: A pact with a being of the upper planes: healing light and radiant fire.

healingLight.name: Bonus Cantrips and Healing Light
healingLight.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: heal one ally 2d6 + Charisma.

radiantSoul.name: Radiant Soul
radiantSoul.text: Resistance to radiant damage, and +2 to your spell damage rolls.

celestialResilience.name: Celestial Resilience
celestialResilience.text: Celestial light lingers in you: +8% max HP.

searingVengeance.name: Searing Vengeance
searingVengeance.text: The first time you would drop to 0 HP in a fight, you stay at 1 HP instead.

fathomless.name: The Fathomless
fathomless.summary: A pact with something in the deep sea: tentacles, cold and crushing water.

tentacleOfTheDeeps.name: Tentacle of the Deeps and Gift of the Sea
tentacleOfTheDeeps.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: a spectral tentacle lashes one foe for 2d6 cold and slows it for 1 round.

oceanicSoul.name: Oceanic Soul and Guardian Coil
oceanicSoul.text: Resistance to cold, and +1 AC from your coiling tentacle.

graspingTentacles.name: Grasping Tentacles
graspingTentacles.text: Action, once per long rest: tentacles burst from the ground under one rank of foes. Each makes a Strength save or is restrained for 2 rounds.

fathomlessPlunge.name: Fathomless Plunge
fathomlessPlunge.text: Bonus Action, once per short rest: pull the party into the deep and back. Every ally is blurred for 1 round.

genie.name: The Genie
genie.summary: A pact with a noble genie: elemental wrath and a magic vessel to rest in.

genieVessel.name: Genie's Vessel and Genie's Wrath
genieVessel.text: Your weapon hits add 1d4 fire, and +2 to your spell damage rolls.

sanctuaryVessel.name: Sanctuary Vessel
sanctuaryVessel.text: Bonus Action, once per long rest: the party rests a moment in your vessel. Every ally gains temporary HP equal to half your level (×vitality).

limitedWish.name: Limited Wish
limitedWish.text: Action, once per long rest: ask your patron for help. Every ally heals 3d8 + Charisma.

greatOldOne.name: The Great Old One
greatOldOne.summary: A pact with an unknowable entity: telepathy, warded thoughts and enthralled foes.

awakenedMind.name: Awakened Mind
awakenedMind.text: You hear thoughts: proficiency in Insight and +1 to your spell damage rolls.

entropicWard.name: Entropic Ward
entropicWard.text: Entropy turns the first blow aside: the first hit you take each fight deals nothing.

thoughtShield.name: Thought Shield
thoughtShield.text: Resistance to psychic damage, and melee attackers that hit you take psychic damage equal to your level.

createThrall.name: Create Thrall
createThrall.text: Action, once per long rest: enthral one foe. It makes a Wisdom save or is charmed for 3 rounds.

hexblade.name: The Hexblade
hexblade.summary: A pact with a sentient weapon from the Shadowfell: curse a foe and cut it down.

hexWarrior.name: Hex Warrior
hexWarrior.text: Training with medium armour, shields and martial weapons, and you attack with Charisma.

hexbladesCurse.name: Hexblade's Curse
hexbladesCurse.text: Bonus Action, once per short rest: curse one foe for 10 rounds. Your hits on it add 1d6 necrotic.

accursedSpecter.name: Accursed Specter
accursedSpecter.text: The souls you take serve you: each kill heals you 5% of your max HP and gives +1 reroll that turn.

masterOfHexes.name: Master of Hexes
masterOfHexes.text: Your curse jumps to new victims: +2 Hexblade's Curse uses, and crits on 19–20.

undead.name: The Undead
undead.summary: A pact with a lich or vampire lord: you take on a dreadful form and death can't hold you.

formOfDread.name: Form of Dread
formOfDread.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: take on a dreadful form, gaining temporary HP equal to your level (×vitality). You can't be frightened.

graveTouched.name: Grave Touched
graveTouched.text: Your weapon hits add 1d4 necrotic, and +2 to your spell damage rolls.

necroticHusk.name: Necrotic Husk
necroticHusk.text: Resistance to necrotic damage, and the first time you would drop to 0 HP in a fight, you stay at 1 HP instead.

spiritProjection.name: Spirit Projection
spiritProjection.text: Bonus Action, once per long rest: project your spirit. Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing for 10 rounds.

undying.name: The Undying
undying.summary: A pact with a being that cheated death, and wants you to do the same.

amongTheDead.name: Among the Dead
amongTheDead.text: The dead leave you be: resistance to necrotic damage.

defyDeath.name: Defy Death
defyDeath.text: The first time you would drop to 0 HP in a fight, you stay at 1 HP instead.

undyingNature.name: Undying Nature
undyingNature.text: You barely age or tire: +10% max HP and resistance to poison.

indestructibleLife.name: Indestructible Life
indestructibleLife.text: Bonus Action, once per short rest: your wounds close. Heal 3d8 + your level.

evoker.name: Evoker
evoker.summary: Masters of destructive magic who shape blasts around their friends.

potentCantrip.name: Potent Cantrip
potentCantrip.text: Cantrips that miss or are saved against still deal half damage.

sculptSpells.name: Sculpt Spells
sculptSpells.text: Your area spells never strike allies (already true here) and deal +2 Mult when hitting 3+ foes.

overchannel.name: Overchannel
overchannel.text: Once per long rest, a spell of 5th level or lower deals maximum dice damage.

bladesinging.name: Bladesinging
bladesinging.summary: Elven sword-dancers who weave spells into swordplay.

bladesong.name: Training in War and Song, Bladesong
bladesong.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: start the bladesong. +3 AC for 10 rounds. You also know Performance and use martial weapons.

extraAttack.name: Extra Attack
extraAttack.text: Attack twice whenever you take the Attack action.

songOfDefense.name: Song of Defense
songOfDefense.text: You turn magic into a shield: +1 AC.

songOfVictory.name: Song of Victory
songOfVictory.text: Your mind sharpens your blade: +10% to all your damage.

chronurgy.name: Chronurgy Magic
chronurgy.summary: Time magic: you nudge the next few seconds and freeze foes in place.

chronalShift.name: Chronal Shift and Temporal Awareness
chronalShift.text: Bonus Action, twice per long rest: rewind a foe's moment. It is weakened (disadvantage on its next attack) for 1 round. You also gain +3 initiative.

momentaryStasis.name: Momentary Stasis
momentaryStasis.text: Action, Intelligence modifier times per long rest: freeze one foe in time. It makes a Constitution save or is incapacitated for 1 round.

arcaneAbeyance.name: Arcane Abeyance
arcaneAbeyance.text: You keep a spell suspended for later: one extra 4th-level slot.

convergentFuture.name: Convergent Future
convergentFuture.text: You see where the dice will land: +1 reroll on each of your turns.

graviturgy.name: Graviturgy Magic
graviturgy.summary: Gravity magic: you make foes heavy and pull them into the ground.

adjustDensity.name: Adjust Density
adjustDensity.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: make one foe heavy. It makes a Strength save or is slowed for 2 rounds.

gravityWell.name: Gravity Well
gravityWell.text: Your spells drag foes where you want them: +2 to your spell damage rolls.

violentAttraction.name: Violent Attraction
violentAttraction.text: You add gravity to every blow: +6% to all your damage.

eventHorizon.name: Event Horizon
eventHorizon.text: Action, once per long rest: every foe makes a Strength save or takes 6d10 force and is restrained for 2 rounds.

scribes.name: Order of Scribes
scribes.summary: Your spellbook is awake, and your quill writes magic as fast as you think.

awakenedSpellbook.name: Wizardly Quill and Awakened Spellbook
awakenedSpellbook.text: Your book helps you shape spells: +1 to your spell damage rolls and +1 skill trick per fight.

manifestMind.name: Manifest Mind
manifestMind.text: Your book's mind casts alongside you: one extra 2nd-level slot.

masterScrivener.name: Master Scrivener
masterScrivener.text: You write a spell scroll every rest: one extra 3rd-level slot.

oneWithTheWord.name: One with the Word
oneWithTheWord.text: Your book takes the blow for you: the first time you would drop to 0 HP in a fight, you stay at 1 HP instead.

abjuration.name: School of Abjuration
abjuration.summary: Protective magic: an arcane ward soaks blows for you and your friends.

arcaneWard.name: Abjuration Savant and Arcane Ward
arcaneWard.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: raise a ward of temporary HP equal to your level (×vitality).

projectedWard.name: Projected Ward
projectedWard.text: Bonus Action, spend an Arcane Ward use: project a ward onto an ally, temporary HP equal to 3/4 of your level (×vitality).

improvedAbjuration.name: Improved Abjuration
improvedAbjuration.text: +1 to all saving throws and +1 spell save DC.

spellResistance.name: Spell Resistance
spellResistance.text: Resistance to force and psychic damage, and +1 to all saving throws.

conjuration.name: School of Conjuration
conjuration.summary: Summoning and teleport magic: things appear where you want them, including you.

minorConjuration.name: Conjuration Savant and Minor Conjuration
minorConjuration.text: You conjure a lucky coin before every expedition: start each expedition with a Fate Coin token.

benignTransposition.name: Benign Transposition
benignTransposition.text: Bonus Action, once per long rest: teleport out of harm. You are blurred for 2 rounds.

focusedConjuration.name: Focused Conjuration
focusedConjuration.text: Your concentration is hard to break: +1 to all saving throws.

durableSummons.name: Durable Summons
durableSummons.text: Your conjured things last: +2 to your spell damage rolls and +5% max HP.

divination.name: School of Divination
divination.summary: You see the future, and you remember which dice are coming.

portent.name: Divination Savant and Portent
portent.text: You glimpse the fight before it starts: each fight opens with a Wild die on the tray.

expertDivination.name: Expert Divination
expertDivination.text: Divining refreshes your magic: one extra 1st-level and one extra 2nd-level slot.

theThirdEye.name: The Third Eye
theThirdEye.text: You see what others miss: +3 initiative and proficiency in Perception.

greaterPortent.name: Greater Portent
greaterPortent.text: Your visions grow: another Wild die opens each fight, and you start each expedition with a Fate Coin.

enchantment.name: School of Enchantment
enchantment.summary: Charm magic: a gaze that freezes foes and words that turn them aside.

hypnoticGaze.name: Enchantment Savant and Hypnotic Gaze
hypnoticGaze.text: Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: fix your gaze on one foe. It makes a Wisdom save or is charmed for 1 round.

instinctiveCharm.name: Instinctive Charm
instinctiveCharm.text: Attackers turn their blows elsewhere: the first hit you take each fight deals nothing.

splitEnchantment.name: Split Enchantment
splitEnchantment.text: Your charms are harder to resist: +1 spell save DC.

alterMemories.name: Alter Memories
alterMemories.text: You blur what foes remember: +1 spell save DC and +1 skill trick per fight.

illusion.name: School of Illusion
illusion.summary: Illusions so good they become real, including copies of you.

improvedMinorIllusion.name: Illusion Savant and Improved Minor Illusion
improvedMinorIllusion.text: Proficiency in Deception, and +1 skill trick per fight.

malleableIllusions.name: Malleable Illusions
malleableIllusions.text: Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: fill one foe's eyes with illusion. It makes an Intelligence save or is blinded for 1 round.

illusorySelf.name: Illusory Self
illusorySelf.text: A copy of you takes the first blow: the first hit you take each fight deals nothing.

illusoryReality.name: Illusory Reality
illusoryReality.text: Your illusions become real: +1 spell save DC and +2 to your spell damage rolls.

necromancy.name: School of Necromancy
necromancy.summary: Death magic: you feed on the souls you take and raise thralls.

grimHarvest.name: Necromancy Savant and Grim Harvest
grimHarvest.text: Each kill heals you 10% of your max HP.

undeadThralls.name: Undead Thralls
undeadThralls.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: a thrall claws one foe for 2d6 + Intelligence necrotic.

inuredToUndeath.name: Inured to Undeath
inuredToUndeath.text: Resistance to necrotic damage, and +5% max HP.

commandUndead.name: Command Undead
commandUndead.text: Action, once per long rest: bend one foe to your will. It makes a Charisma save or is charmed for 3 rounds.

transmutation.name: School of Transmutation
transmutation.summary: You change what things are, from lead to gold and from wounds to health.

minorAlchemy.name: Transmutation Savant and Minor Alchemy
minorAlchemy.text: Proficiency in Nature, and +1 skill trick per fight.

transmutersStone.name: Transmuter's Stone
transmutersStone.text: Your stone protects you: +1 to all saving throws and resistance to fire.

shapechanger.name: Shapechanger
shapechanger.text: Bonus Action, once per short rest: transform your body. Temporary HP equal to twice your level (×vitality).

masterTransmuter.name: Master Transmuter
masterTransmuter.text: Action, once per long rest: use up your stone to restore one ally, healing 6d8 + your level.

warMagic.name: War Magic
warMagic.summary: Battle wizards trained to fight and to survive the fight.

arcaneDeflection.name: Arcane Deflection and Tactical Wit
arcaneDeflection.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per short rest: +2 AC until your next turn. You also gain +3 initiative.

powerSurge.name: Power Surge
powerSurge.text: Stored magic boosts your spells: +2 to your spell damage rolls.

durableMagic.name: Durable Magic
durableMagic.text: While you hold a spell you are harder to hit: +1 AC and +1 to all saving throws.

deflectingShroud.name: Deflecting Shroud
deflectingShroud.text: Deflected magic lashes out: melee attackers that hit you take force damage equal to your level.

alchemist.name: Alchemist
alchemist.summary: Potions, elixirs and reagents: you heal friends and dissolve foes.

experimentalElixir.name: Tool Proficiency and Experimental Elixir
experimentalElixir.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: hand an ally a healing elixir for 2d4 + Intelligence. You also know Medicine.

alchemicalSavant.name: Alchemical Savant
alchemicalSavant.text: +2 to your spell damage rolls, and healing you give is 15% stronger.

restorativeReagents.name: Restorative Reagents
restorativeReagents.text: Bonus Action, Intelligence modifier times per long rest: every ally gains temporary HP equal to half your level (×vitality).

chemicalMastery.name: Chemical Mastery
chemicalMastery.text: Resistance to acid and poison, and you can't be poisoned.

armorer.name: Armorer
armorer.summary: You rebuild your armour into a suit of thunder gauntlets and wards.

arcaneArmor.name: Tools of the Trade, Arcane Armor and Guardian Model
arcaneArmor.text: Training with heavy armour, +1 AC, and your thunder gauntlets add 1d4 thunder to weapon hits.

extraAttack.name: Extra Attack
extraAttack.text: Attack twice whenever you take the Attack action.

armorModifications.name: Armor Modifications
armorModifications.text: More infusions fit in your armour: +5% max HP.

perfectedArmor.name: Perfected Armor
perfectedArmor.text: Your armour lashes out: melee attackers that hit you take lightning damage equal to twice your level.

artillerist.name: Artillerist
artillerist.summary: An eldritch cannon and an arcane firearm: magic as artillery.

eldritchCannon.name: Tool Proficiency and Eldritch Cannon
eldritchCannon.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per short rest: your cannon breathes flame over one rank of foes for 2d8 fire (Dexterity save halves).

explosiveCannon.name: Explosive Cannon
explosiveCannon.text: Your cannon fires more often: +2 Eldritch Cannon uses.

fortifiedPosition.name: Fortified Position
fortifiedPosition.text: Bonus Action, once per long rest: your cannons throw up cover. Every ally gains +2 AC for 3 rounds.

battleSmith.name: Battle Smith
battleSmith.summary: A steel defender fights beside you, and you fight with your mind.

battleReady.name: Battle Ready
battleReady.text: Proficiency with martial weapons, and you attack with Intelligence.

steelDefender.name: Steel Defender
steelDefender.text: Bonus Action, proficiency bonus times per short rest: your steel defender strikes one foe for 1d8 + Intelligence force.

extraAttack.name: Extra Attack
extraAttack.text: Attack twice whenever you take the Attack action.

improvedDefender.name: Improved Defender
improvedDefender.text: Your defender guards you closely: +1 AC, and melee attackers that hit you take force damage equal to your level.
